words.ex: The printing press made books cheaper and easier to find.
words.ex_cn: 印刷机让书籍更便宜、更容易找到。
words.en: A printing press is a machine used for printing text or pictures from type or plates.

words.ex: He has many problems with math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上有很多问题。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: He is good at problem solving in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上擅长解决问题。
words.en: The process of finding solutions to difficult or complex issues.

words.ex: The store sells many new products.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售许多新产品。
words.en: Goods or services that are produced and sold, especially in large quantities.

words.ex: The factory increases its production every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每年都在增加生产。
words.en: Production refers to the process of manufacturing or growing something in large quantities, or the amount of something that is manufactured or grown.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.ex: The company made big profits this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profits are the money that a business earns after subtracting all its costs and expenses.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection to his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: Protection is the act of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected.

words.ex: The company has a strong protection policy for customer data.
words.ex_cn: 该公司对客户数据有强大的保护政策。
words.en: A protection policy refers to a set of measures or strategies designed to safeguard the interests, rights, or welfare of a particular group, sector, or entity against external threats or competition.

words.ex: Workers wear protective clothing to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 工人们穿防护服以确保安全。
words.en: Protective clothing refers to garments designed to protect the wearer's body from injury or infection. The hazards addressed by protective clothing include physical, electrical, heat, chemicals, biohazards, and airborne particulate matter.

words.tr:
adj. 公众的；
n. 公众；公共场所；
words.ex: The park is open to the public.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对公众开放。
words.en: Relating to or involving people in general, rather than being limited to a particular group of people.

words.ex: People gather in the public square to celebrate.
words.ex_cn: 人们聚集在公共广场上庆祝。
words.en: An open area in a city or town, often surrounded by buildings and used for public gatherings, markets, or ceremonies.

words.ex: The children play in the public areas after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公共区域玩耍。
words.en: Places that are open and accessible to all people, such as parks, streets, and public buildings.

words.ex: He takes public transportation to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: Public transportation refers to the system of buses, trains, subways, etc., that is available for use by the public and is usually operated by a government or private company.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听无线电。
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.tr: phrase. 广播节目；电台节目
words.ex: He listens to a radio program every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听一个广播节目。
words.en: A radio program is a segment of content intended for broadcast on radio. It may be a one-time production or part of a periodically recurring series.

words.ex: The plane receives radio signals from the tower.
words.ex_cn: 飞机从塔台接收无线电信号。
words.en: Radio signals are electromagnetic waves used to transmit information through space without the need for a physical connection.

words.ex: It is raining outside.
words.ex_cn: 外面正在下雨。
words.en: The process of water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere.

words.ex: He wears rainwear when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他穿雨衣。
words.en: Clothing designed to protect against rain.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.ex: He collects rainwater in a barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他用桶收集雨水。
words.en: Rainwater is water that has fallen as rain and is often collected and used for various purposes, such as watering plants.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.ex: He reads aloud to his little sister every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上为他的小妹妹大声朗读。
words.en: To speak the words that you are reading, so that other people can hear them.

words.ex: The readability of this book is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的可读性非常高。
words.en: The quality of being clear and easy to read.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.ex: The children played with the recorders in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在教室里玩录像机。
words.en: Recorders are devices used to capture sound or data for playback or analysis.

words.tr: n. 录音；录制； v. 记录；录制；“record”的现在分词；
words.ex: I listened to the recording of the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我听了讲座的录音。
words.en: A recording is a piece of music or speech that has been recorded, or the process of making such a record.

words.tr: n. 介绍信；参考；引用；提及；“reference”的复数；
words.ex: He gave me three references for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提供了三封介绍信用于这份工作。
words.en: References are mentions of something or someone, or the act of looking at something for information.

words.tr: phrase. 咨询号码；参考号码
words.ex: Please call the hotline and give your reference number.
words.ex_cn: 请拨打热线并提供你的咨询号码。
words.en: A reference number is a unique identifier assigned to a specific transaction or document, used for tracking and identification purposes.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.ex: His research approach is simple and clear.
words.ex_cn: 他的研究方法简单而清晰。
words.en: A method or strategy used in conducting research, which may involve qualitative, quantitative, or mixed methods to investigate a particular phenomenon or question.

words.tr: phrase. 研究结果；研究发现
words.ex: The scientists shared their research findings with the public.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们将他们的研究发现与公众分享。
words.en: The results or outcomes of a study or investigation.

words.tr: n. 报告；报道；“report”的复数； v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: The students handed in their science reports yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 学生们昨天交上了他们的科学报告。
words.en: Reports are detailed accounts or statements about a particular subject, especially one that is investigated or analyzed. They can also refer to the act of reporting or the process of gathering and presenting information.

words.ex: The reporter asked the president a difficult question.
words.ex_cn: 记者问了总统一个困难的问题。
words.en: A reporter is a person whose job is to discover information about news events and describe them for a newspaper, magazine, radio, or television.

words.ex: He is doing report writing for his science class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为科学课写报告。
words.en: Report writing is the process of creating a document that presents information in a structured format, often for business, scientific, or technical purposes. It involves researching, organizing, and presenting data and findings in a clear and concise manner.

words.ex: The rivers flow into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入大海。
words.en: Rivers are large natural streams of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

words.ex: We walked along the riverside at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时沿着河边散步。
words.en: The area of land along the edge of a river.

words.ex: We went on a river trip last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去进行了河上旅行。
words.en: A journey or excursion taken on a river, typically for leisure or exploration.

words.ex: The hotel has a river view.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有河景。
words.en: A view of a river, especially one that is considered beautiful or scenic.

words.ex: The roads are busy in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上的道路很繁忙。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: The city built a road map for new buses.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市为新公交车绘制了一张道路图。
words.en: A road map is a plan or strategy intended to achieve a particular goal.

words.ex: The boy picked up a piece of rubber from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块橡胶。
words.en: Rubber is a strong, waterproof, elastic substance made from the juice of some tropical plants or artificially. It is used for making tires, boots, and many other products.

words.ex: The worker placed a rubber blanket on the floor to prevent slipping.
words.ex_cn: 工人在地板上铺了一块橡胶垫以防滑倒。
words.en: A flexible, waterproof sheet made of rubber, used for protection or insulation.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet improves your safety.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔能提高你的安全。
words.en: Safety refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.

words.ex: The fence safeguards the garden from animals.
words.ex_cn: 围栏保护花园免受动物侵扰。
words.en: A safeguard is a measure taken to protect someone or something from potential harm or danger.

words.ex: Follow the safety rules at the construction site.
words.ex_cn: 在建筑工地遵守安全规定。
words.en: Regulations or principles designed to ensure safety and prevent accidents or injuries.

words.ex: Workers must follow safety regulations at the site.
words.ex_cn: 工人必须遵守现场的安全规定。
words.en: Rules or directives made and maintained by an authority to ensure safety.

words.ex: The pilot does a safety check before takeoff.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在起飞前进行安全检查。
words.en: An inspection or examination to ensure that something is safe or in proper condition.

words.tr: n. 色拉；凉拌生菜；“salad”的复数
words.ex: She eats salads every day for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她每天午餐都吃沙拉。
words.en: A mixture of raw vegetables, typically served as a dish, either alone or combined with other foods.

words.ex: He picked his dinner from the salad bar.
words.ex_cn: 他从沙拉吧挑选了他的晚餐。
words.en: A salad bar is a buffet-style table or counter at a restaurant or food service facility where customers can assemble their own salad plates from a variety of ingredients.

words.tr: n. 航海；帆船运动； v. 航行；“sail”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves sailing on the open sea.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱在公海上航海。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving across water in a boat that is propelled by the wind.

words.ex: The schools are open every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 这些学校每个工作日都开放。
words.en: A school is an institution designed for the teaching of students under the direction of teachers.

words.ex: He paid the school fees with his savings.
words.ex_cn: 他用储蓄支付了学费。
words.en: The amount of money that is charged for teaching by a school, especially a private one.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: He uses scientific methods to test his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用科学方法来测试他的想法。
words.en: Scientific means relating to science or using the methods of science.

words.ex: He does scientific research in a lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室做科学研究。
words.en: Scientific research refers to the systematic investigation into and study of materials and sources in order to establish facts and reach new conclusions.

words.ex: Scientists made scientific explorations in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们在沙漠中进行了科学探索。
words.en: Scientific explorations refer to the systematic investigation into and study of materials and sources in order to establish facts and reach new conclusions in the field of science.

words.ex: Fish swim among the seagrass near the shore.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在岸边的海草间游动。
words.en: Seagrass refers to any of various submerged marine plants with long, narrow leaves that grow in dense groups in shallow coastal waters.

words.ex: The sea level is rising because of global warming.
words.ex_cn: 由于全球变暖，海平面正在上升。
words.en: The average height of the sea's surface, used as a basis for measuring heights and depths on land.

words.ex: He learned to love his self.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了爱自己。
words.en: Your self is your basic personality or nature, especially considered in terms of what you are really like as a person.

words.tr: adj. 自己经营的；个体经营的；非受雇于人的
words.ex: He is self-employed and works from home.
words.ex_cn: 他是自由职业者，在家工作。
words.en: Someone who is self-employed works for themselves rather than for an employer.

words.tr: adj. 以自我为中心的；自私的
words.ex: He is self-centered and never listens to others.
words.ex_cn: 他以自我为中心，从不听别人的话。
words.en: Someone who is self-centered is only concerned with their own needs and interests and does not consider the needs or wishes of other people.

words.ex: Students use the self-access lab to practice English.
words.ex_cn: 学生使用自主学习实验室练习英语。
words.en: A self-access lab is a facility provided by educational institutions where students can engage in independent learning activities, often with the use of computers and other resources.

words.ex: He did a self-evaluation after the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试后做了自我评估。
words.en: The act of assessing one's own abilities, performance, or qualities.

words.ex: The self-locking door stays closed without a key.
words.ex_cn: 自锁门不用钥匙也能保持关闭。
words.en: A self-locking device or mechanism is one that locks automatically and cannot be opened without a specific action or key.

words.ex: They went on a self-drive trip across the country.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次自驾游，横跨全国。
words.en: A self-drive vehicle is one that you drive yourself rather than one that is driven by a chauffeur or another person.

words.ex: He learned self-defense to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 他学习了自卫以确保安全。
words.en: Self-defense is the act of defending oneself, one's property, or a close relative from physical harm.

words.ex: The ships sail across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 这些船在海洋上航行。
words.en: A ship is a large boat for travelling on water, especially across the sea. Ships are used for carrying people or goods.

words.tr: n. 航运；船运；运输； v. 装运；“ship”的现在分词；
words.ex: The shipping industry moves goods across oceans.
words.ex_cn: 航运业将货物运过海洋。
words.en: The act of sending goods from one place to another, especially by ship.

words.ex: He works in shipbuilding near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他在海边从事造船工作。
words.en: The industry or activity of building ships.

words.ex: There are many shops on this street.
words.ex_cn: 这条街上有很多商店。
words.en: Shops are places where goods are sold to the public. As a verb, to shop means to visit shops to buy goods.

words.ex: The shoppers bought apples and bread at the market.
words.ex_cn: 顾客们在市场买了苹果和面包。
words.en: People who are shopping or intending to shop.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.tr: phrase. 商业区；大商场；大型购物中心
words.ex: We went to the shopping mall to buy clothes and eat dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们去商业区买衣服和吃晚饭。
words.en: A shopping mall is a large building or group of buildings containing a variety of stores and often restaurants and other business establishments situated close together.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: She wrapped the candy in silver paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用银色纸包了糖果。
words.en: Silver paper refers to a thin, metallic paper that is used for wrapping or decorative purposes, often resembling the appearance of silver.

words.tr: n. 技能；技巧；技术；“skill”的复数；
words.ex: He developed many skills through practice.
words.ex_cn: 他通过练习掌握了多种技能。
words.en: Skills are the abilities and knowledge that you need in order to do a job or activity.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: The children played with stones in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在院子里玩石子。
words.en: Hard solid non-metallic mineral matter of which rock is made, especially as a building material.

words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨在夜间爆发了。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.ex: The student reads a book every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个学生每天读书。
words.en: A student is a person who is studying at a university or college.

words.ex: He shows his student card to get a discount.
words.ex_cn: 他出示学生证来获得折扣。
words.en: A card issued by an educational institution to a student, which is used to identify the student and may provide access to certain facilities or services.

words.ex: He took a student loan to pay for his tuition.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了学生贷款来支付学费。
words.en: A student loan is a sum of money borrowed by a student to help pay for their education, which they must repay, often with interest, after they finish their studies.

words.ex: The school offers student support for those who need help.
words.ex_cn: 学校为需要帮助的学生提供支持。
words.en: Assistance provided to students to help them succeed academically and personally.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍；学生公寓；供学生居住的住所
words.ex: The student home is near the university campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生宿舍靠近大学校园。
words.en: A place of residence for students, often located near their educational institution.

words.ex: Children enjoy social activities like games and group projects.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢参加游戏和小组项目等社会活动。
words.en: Social activities refer to events or gatherings where people interact with each other in a social context, often for enjoyment, networking, or community building.

words.ex: They went to a social event last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚去参加了一个社交活动。
words.en: A social event is a gathering of people for the purpose of socializing, entertainment, or celebration.

words.ex: People use social information to decide what to buy.
words.ex_cn: 人们利用社会信息来决定购买什么。
words.en: Information that is related to society or social interactions, often used in studies to understand human behavior in a social context.

words.ex: He is improving his social skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在工作中提升自己的社交技能。
words.en: Social skills are the skills we use to communicate and interact with each other, both verbally and non-verbally, through gestures, body language and our personal appearance.

words.ex: People in society should be kind to each other.
words.ex_cn: 社会中的人们应该彼此友善。
words.en: A society is the people who live in a country or region, their organizations, and their way of life.

words.ex: He is a sociable man who likes to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢和朋友聊天的外向的人。
words.en: A sociable person is friendly and enjoys being with other people.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头很软，很舒服。
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.ex: He uses software to write his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他使用软件写作业。
words.en: Software refers to the programs and other operating information used by a computer.

words.ex: The waves moved the soft sediment on the sea floor.
words.ex_cn: 海浪移动了海底的软沉积物。
words.en: Soft sediment refers to the accumulation of particles that have settled from suspension in a fluid, typically water, and are not yet compacted into rock.

words.tr: n. 空地；空间；空白；“space”的复数；
words.ex: The children play in the open spaces.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在空地上玩耍。
words.en: Spaces refer to the areas that are empty or available for use, or the distances between things.

words.ex: We visited a space museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们参观了一个太空博物馆。
words.en: A space museum is a museum that focuses on the history and science of space exploration and astronomy.

words.tr:
adj. 特别的；特殊的；
n. 特价；特色菜；专车；特别的物品；
words.ex: This is a special day for me.
words.ex_cn: 这一天对我来说很特别。
words.en: Something that is special is different from normal things, or is considered to be better than normal things.

words.tr: phrase. 特价商品；特价销售
words.ex: The store has special offers on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在周末有特价优惠。
words.en: Special offers are discounts or deals that are available for a limited time to encourage people to buy a product or service.

words.ex: He uses a special code to open the safe.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一个特殊代码来打开保险箱。
words.en: A unique sequence of characters used for identification, encryption, or access.

words.ex: The school provides special buses for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供专用公交车。
words.en: Buses that are designated for specific purposes or groups, such as transportation for the elderly, disabled, or for school children.

words.tr: adj. 特定的；明确的；具体的；
words.ex: He gave a specific reason for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个迟到的具体原因。
words.en: If someone is specific, they give a description that is precise and exact.

words.tr: adj. 专门的；专业的； v. “specialize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a specialized job in computer repair.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作是专门修理电脑的。
words.en: Requiring or involving detailed and specific knowledge or training.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: He loves playing sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: Sports are physical activities or games, often competitive and organized, that involve skill and physical exertion.

words.ex: He bought new sports equipment for the game.
words.ex_cn: 他为比赛买了新的体育器材。
words.en: The items used in sports or physical activities, such as balls, bats, gloves, and protective gear.

words.ex: The gym offers free sports service to all members.
words.ex_cn: 健身房为所有会员提供免费的体育服务。
words.en: Services related to sports activities provided to the public or specific groups to promote physical activity, health, and well-being.

words.ex: He goes to the sports center every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六都去体育中心。
words.en: A sports center is a place where people can go to participate in various sports and physical activities. It typically includes facilities such as gyms, swimming pools, and courts for games like basketball and tennis.

words.ex: He got a sports injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了运动损伤。
words.en: An injury that occurs as a result of participating in sports or physical activities.

words.ex: The students play basketball in the sports hall.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在体育馆打篮球。
words.en: A large room or building designed for indoor sports activities.

words.tr: n. 调查；勘测；“survey”的复数； v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did surveys about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: Surveys are a method of gathering information from a sample of people, traditionally with the intention of generalizing the results to a larger population.

words.tr: phrase. 调查方法；用于收集数据和信息的系统性技术或程序
words.ex: The teacher used simple survey methods to collect student opinions.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用了简单的调查方法来收集学生的意见。
words.en: Survey methods refer to the techniques and procedures used to collect data from a sample of individuals or entities for the purposes of research or analysis.

words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The star around which the earth orbits, providing light and warmth.

words.ex: We watched the sunset by the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海滩上看了夕阳。
words.en: The time in the evening when the sun disappears or daylight fades.

words.ex: He puts on sun-cream before going to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他去海滩前涂上防晒霜。
words.en: A cream or lotion applied to the skin to protect it from the harmful effects of the sun's ultraviolet rays.

words.ex: She wears a sun hat at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 她在海滩上戴一顶太阳帽。
words.en: A sun hat is a hat that you wear to protect your head and face from the sun.

words.ex: The sun position changes during the day.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的位置在一天中会变化。
words.en: The location of the sun in the sky at a particular time and place.

words.ex: The sun position changes during the day.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的位置在一天中会变化。
words.en: The location of the sun in the sky at a particular time and place.

words.ex: He gave his tax number to the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的税号给了银行。
words.en: A tax number is a unique identifier assigned by the government to individuals or entities for the purpose of tracking tax obligations and payments.

words.tr: n. （十三到十九岁的）青少年；“teenager”的复数；
words.ex: Teenagers often spend a lot of time on their phones.
words.ex_cn: 青少年经常花很多时间在手机上。
words.en: Teenagers are young people between the ages of 13 and 19.

words.ex: He works in a technical department.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个技术部门工作。
words.en: Technical means involving the sorts of machines, processes, and materials that are used in industry, transport, and communications.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: New technology helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助农民种植更多的粮食。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: They play tennis on the tennis court every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期天在网球场打网球。
words.en: A tennis court is the place where the game of tennis is played.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间完成作业。
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.ex: Doing homework by hand is time-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手写作业很耗时。
words.en: If you describe an activity as time-consuming, you mean that it takes a lot of time to do.

words.tr: n. 时间表；时刻表；课程表；
words.ex: The school publishes a new timetable every term.
words.ex_cn: 学校每学期都会公布新的时间表。
words.en: A timetable is a detailed plan showing the times at which things are intended to happen, especially the times at which particular events or activities are planned to occur.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.ex: He is a top level manager in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司的一名高级经理。
words.en: Relating to the highest level of an organization or system.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.ex: Tourism brings money to small towns.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业为小镇带来收入。
words.en: Tourism is the business of providing services for people on holiday, for example hotels, restaurants, and trips.

words.tr: n. 旅游者；观光者；“tourist”的复数；
words.ex: Many tourists visit the Great Wall every year.
words.ex_cn: 每年有许多旅游者参观长城。
words.en: Tourists are people who are visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.ex: He visited the tourist office for maps.
words.ex_cn: 他去旅游办公室要地图。
words.en: A place where tourists can get information about the area they are visiting, including maps, brochures, and advice on attractions and accommodations.

words.ex: He lives in a small town near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小镇上。
words.en: A town is a place with many streets and buildings, where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.

words.ex: The meeting will be held at the town hall.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在市政厅举行。
words.en: A town hall is a building used for the administration of local government, or a meeting at which a public official or political candidate addresses an audience.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.ex: The traffic flow is slow during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通流量很慢。
words.en: The movement of vehicles or pedestrians along a street or other route.

words.ex: The car stopped at the traffic light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红绿灯前停了下来。
words.en: A traffic light is a set of automatically operated coloured lights, typically red, amber, and green, for controlling traffic at road junctions, pedestrian crossings, and roundabouts.

words.ex: The traffic noise keeps me awake at night.
words.ex_cn: 交通噪音让我晚上睡不着。
words.en: Traffic noise refers to the sound produced by vehicles on the road, including cars, trucks, motorcycles, and buses, which can be a source of environmental pollution.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.ex: The transport service runs every hour.
words.ex_cn: 交通运输服务每小时运行一次。
words.en: A service provided for the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

words.ex: The trains arrive every hour.
words.ex_cn: 火车每小时到达一次。
words.en: To train means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills. It can also refer to a series of connected railway carriages or wagons moved by a locomotive or by integral motors.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: n. 导师；家庭教师；“tutor”的复数；
words.ex: The students meet their tutors every week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每周都见他们的导师。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one student or a very small group of students. As a verb, to tutor means to teach someone privately.

words.ex: He watches online tutorials to learn coding.
words.ex_cn: 他观看在线教程来学习编程。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching given by a tutor to an individual or a small group of students.

words.ex: The neighbor gave an unfriendly look.
words.ex_cn: 邻居给了一个不友好的眼神。
words.en: If you describe someone as unfriendly, you mean that they behave in a hostile or unsympathetic way.

words.tr:
adj. 无装备的；无家具设备的
v. 搬走家具；“unfurnish”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The apartment is unfurnished.
words.ex_cn: 这个公寓没有家具。
words.en: If a room or house is unfurnished, it does not contain any furniture.

words.ex: The movie showed an unnatural movement of the trees.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了树木不合自然规律的运动。
words.en: If you describe something as unnatural, you mean that it is not normal or not what you usually expect, especially in a way that is unpleasant or worrying.

words.tr: adj. 无限制的；无限量的；
words.ex: He has unlimited access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他可以无限制地使用图书馆。
words.en: If something is unlimited, there is no limit to it.

words.tr: adj. 使人不舒服的；不自在的；
words.ex: The chair is uncomfortable to sit on.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子坐起来让人不舒服。
words.en: If you are uncomfortable, you are slightly worried or embarrassed, and not relaxed and confident.

words.tr: adj. 不确定的；不肯定的；无把握的；
words.ex: I am unsure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案不确定。
words.en: If you are unsure about something, you are not certain about it.

words.ex: Eating too much sugar is unhealthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃太多糖是不健康的。
words.en: If you describe something as unhealthy, you mean that it is likely to cause illness or poor health.

words.ex: He left the unanswered questions on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把那些未回答的问题留在了桌上。
words.en: If a question or problem is unanswered, it has not been answered or solved.

words.tr: adj. 难接近的；不友好的；冷漠的
words.ex: The old man was unapproachable and never smiled.
words.ex_cn: 那位老人难以接近，从不微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as unapproachable, you mean that they seem unfriendly and not easy to talk to.

words.ex: The village is still undeveloped with no roads or electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄仍然不发达，没有道路和电力。
words.en: An undeveloped area of land is one that has not been used for building or farming.

words.tr: adj. 不合群的；不善交际的；非工作时间的
words.ex: He is unsocial and rarely talks to others.
words.ex_cn: 他不善社交，很少和别人说话。
words.en: Unsocial describes someone who does not enjoy or is not good at socializing with other people.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If something varies or if you vary it, it becomes different or changed.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的；不同的；各种的；
words.ex: He bought various fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you say that there are various things, you mean there are several different things of the type mentioned.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.ex: I ordered a vegetable burger for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐点了一个蔬菜汉堡。
words.en: A vegetable burger is a type of burger that uses vegetables, grains, or legumes as the main ingredients instead of meat.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.ex: He watches videos on YouTube every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在YouTube上看视频。
words.en: Videos are recordings of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.ex: He made a video recording of his dog playing.
words.ex_cn: 他录了一段他狗玩耍的视频。
words.en: The process of capturing moving images on film or digitally.

words.ex: He watches movies with video subtitles to understand better.
words.ex_cn: 他看电影时使用字幕来更好地理解。
words.en: Textual versions of the dialogue or commentary in films, television programs, video games, etc., displayed at the bottom of the screen.

words.ex: He works as a videotape editor for a TV station.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名电视台的录像带编辑。
words.en: A person who edits videotapes, especially for professional broadcasting or film production.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: His viewpoint is different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的不同。
words.en: A viewpoint is a particular way of thinking about something, especially one that is influenced by your experiences or beliefs.

words.ex: The hikers stopped at the viewing shelter to watch the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者在观测点停下来观看日落。
words.en: A viewing shelter is a structure designed to provide protection from the elements while allowing people to observe the surrounding scenery or wildlife.

words.ex: The children walk to school from small villages.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们从各个小村庄步行去上学。
words.en: Small communities in rural areas, typically smaller than a town.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.tr: v. 给…浇水；“water”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is watering the flowers every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上给花浇水。
words.en: The act of pouring or sprinkling water on plants or soil to help them grow.

words.ex: He spends time watering plants every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上花时间浇灌植物。
words.en: The act of supplying water to plants to promote growth and health.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.ex: The water level is rising fast.
words.ex_cn: 水位正在迅速上升。
words.en: The height of the surface of a body of water above a particular point, especially as measured by a gauge.

words.ex: The water collection tank holds rainwater for gardening.
words.ex_cn: 这个集水箱储存雨水用于园艺。
words.en: A container designed to collect and store water, often used in areas where water supply is irregular or scarce.

words.ex: I need to buy a new water heater.
words.ex_cn: 我需要买一个新的热水器。
words.en: A device that heats water for use in homes and businesses.

words.ex: The village uses water power to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄用水力发电。
words.en: Water power is the power that is generated by the movement of water, especially when it is used to produce electricity.

words.ex: The city uses water treatment to make clean water.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市用水处理来制造干净的水。
words.en: The process of making water suitable for a specific end-use, such as drinking, industrial water supply, irrigation, river flow maintenance, water recreation or many other uses, including being safely returned to the environment.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.ex: The weather is sunny today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气晴朗。
words.en: The condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially with regard to temperature, precipitation, and wind.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个轮子。
words.en: Circular objects that revolve on an axle and are fixed below vehicles to enable them to move over the ground.

words.ex: He uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 他使用轮椅来移动。
words.en: A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, injury, or disability.

words.tr: n. 风；“wind”的复数； v. 蜿蜒；
words.ex: The winds blew strongly last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚风刮得很猛烈。
words.en: n. The movement of air, especially when it is strong enough to be felt or to move things; v. To twist or turn something around itself or something else.

words.ex: The windmills turn slowly in the field.
words.ex_cn: 风车在田野里缓缓转动。
words.en: Windmills are structures that convert the energy of wind into rotational energy by means of vanes called sails or blades.

words.ex: He loves wind surfing on the lake every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每个周末在湖上玩风帆冲浪。
words.en: The sport or activity of riding on a surfboard that is propelled by a sail.

words.tr: n. 窗户；窗口；电脑窗口；“window”的复数；
words.ex: The children are looking out of the windows.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正从窗户往外看。
words.en: Windows is an operating system developed by Microsoft, which allows users to manage files and run applications on their computers.

words.ex: The window locks are broken.
words.ex_cn: 窗户锁坏了。
words.en: Devices used to secure windows to prevent them from being opened from the outside.

words.tr: phrase. 窗口的风景；窗口视图
words.ex: I like the window view of the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢窗户看到的山景。
words.en: The scene or vista visible through an opening in a wall, typically a window.

words.ex: The worker fixed the machine quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位工作者迅速修好了机器。
words.en: A worker is a person who does a particular job to earn money.

words.tr: v. 工作；劳动；“work”的现在分词； adj. 工作的；劳动的；
words.ex: He is working in a factory.
words.ex_cn: 他正在工厂工作。
words.en: Engaged in work, especially as one's regular occupation; functioning or able to function.

words.ex: His workload is too heavy this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周的工作量太大了。
words.en: The amount of work to be done by someone, especially in a particular period of time.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.tr: n. 活页练习题；工作记录；工作表
words.ex: The teacher gave the students a worksheet for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们发了一份练习表作为家庭作业。
words.en: A worksheet is a piece of paper on which problems or tasks are set for students or workers to solve or complete.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.ex: The deer live in the woodland near the river.
words.ex_cn: 鹿住在河边的林地中。
words.en: An area of land covered with trees, larger than a wood.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.ex: Young people like to use smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 年轻人喜欢使用智能手机。
words.en: Young people are individuals in the early stages of life, typically characterized by their energy, potential, and the challenges they face in growing up.

words.ex: Young children love to play with colorful toys.
words.ex_cn: 小孩子喜欢玩色彩鲜艳的玩具。
words.en: Young children refer to children who are in the early stages of their life, typically between the ages of one and eight years.

words.ex: Young teenagers often like to play video games after school.
words.ex_cn: 年轻青少年放学后常常喜欢玩电子游戏。
words.en: Young teenagers refers to individuals in the early stages of their teenage years, typically between the ages of 13 and 15.

words.ex: Young graduates are looking for jobs.
words.ex_cn: 年轻毕业生正在找工作。
words.en: Young graduates refer to individuals who have recently completed their studies at a college or university and are beginning their careers.

words.ex: Adults need more sleep than children.
words.ex_cn: 成人比孩子需要更多的睡眠。
words.en: An adult is a person who is fully grown or developed.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: He submitted his academic record to the university.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的学业成绩提交给了大学。
words.en: A document that provides a detailed account of a student's academic performance, including grades, courses taken, and degrees awarded.

words.tr: n. 事故；意外事件；意外；
words.ex: He was hurt in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中受伤了。
words.en: An accident is an unexpected and undesirable event, especially one resulting in damage or harm.

words.ex: His actions showed he was serious.
words.ex_cn: 他的行动表明他是认真的。
words.en: The things that someone does in order to achieve a particular purpose or to deal with a situation.

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.ex: He works as an administration officer in the school office.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校办公室担任行政官员。
words.en: An administration officer is responsible for managing the daily operations and administrative tasks within an organization or department.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.ex: He is taking an advance level math course.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门高级数学课程。
words.en: A high level of knowledge or skill in a particular subject or activity.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.ex: He is answering the phone right now.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接电话。
words.en: The action of responding to an incoming telephone call.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.ex: She wears a white apron while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她做饭时穿着一件白色围裙。
words.en: An apron is a piece of clothing that you wear over the front of your normal clothes and tie round your waist, especially when you are cooking, in order to prevent your clothes from getting dirty.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: A round fruit with firm, white flesh and a green, red, or yellow skin.

words.ex: He drinks apple juice every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝苹果汁。
words.en: A drink made from the juice of apples.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: He filled out the application form yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天填了申请表。
words.en: A document used to apply for something, such as a job or membership, by providing personal information and details.

words.tr: n. 途径；方法；“approach”的复数； v. 接近；靠近；
words.ex: Different approaches can solve the same problem.
words.ex_cn: 不同的途径可以解决同一个问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in space, time, quality, or amount.

words.tr: n. 手臂；武器；兵器；“arm”的复数；
words.ex: He raised his arms to wave at the plane.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂向飞机挥手。
words.en: Weapons, especially as used by the military.

words.ex: He sits in the armchair and reads the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在扶手椅上读报纸。
words.en: An armchair is a comfortable chair with sides that support your arms.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.ex: He sent some attachments with the email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了一些附件。
words.en: Attachments are files that are sent along with an email message.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: The babies are sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿们正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: Very young children, especially those who cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: She carries her books in bags.
words.ex_cn: 她把书放在包里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.ex: He checked his bank statement last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚查看了他的银行对账单。
words.en: A bank statement is a document that shows all the transactions that have occurred in a bank account over a specific period of time, usually a month.

words.tr: phrase. 银行间的转帐； 银行汇款
words.ex: He made a bank transfer to pay his rent.
words.ex_cn: 他通过银行转账支付了房租。
words.en: A bank transfer is a method of transferring money from one bank account to another.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都在卧室睡觉。
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.ex: He lives in a bedsit near the station.
words.ex_cn: 他住在车站附近的一间单间公寓里。
words.en: A bedsit is a single room that serves as both bedroom and living room, often with basic cooking facilities.

words.ex: She washed the bed sheet yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天洗了床单。
words.en: A bed sheet is a large piece of cloth used to cover a mattress, often used in pairs with one sheet below the sleeper and one sheet above.

words.tr: n. 开头；开端； v. 开始；着手；“begin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The beginning of the story is very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的开头非常精彩。
words.en: The point in time or space at which something starts.

words.ex: The class is for beginners who want to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 这个课程是给想学英语的初学者的。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and cannot do it very well yet.

words.ex: Children's behaviors change when they are tired.
words.ex_cn: 孩子累了的时候，他们的表现会改变。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: He lost a lot of blood after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失了很多血。
words.en: The red liquid that flows through the bodies of humans and animals, carrying oxygen and nutrients.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.ex: We had a biology lesson about plants today.
words.ex_cn: 今天我们上了一节关于植物的生物课。
words.en: A biology lesson is a class in which students learn about living organisms and their vital processes.

words.ex: This is a biological experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个生物学实验。
words.en: Relating to biology or living organisms.

words.ex: Farmers use biological control to reduce pests without chemicals.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用生物防治来减少害虫而不使用化学物质。
words.en: The use of living organisms to control pests, weeds, or diseases, especially in agriculture, to reduce the reliance on chemical pesticides.

words.tr: n. 树枝；分支；分公司；分支；“branch”的复数；
words.ex: The wind blew down the branches of the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风把树的树枝吹落了。
words.en: The parts of a tree that grow out from the trunk and have leaves, flowers, or fruit on them.

words.tr:
v. 打破；打断；
n. 休息；中断；破裂；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打破了玻璃。
words.en: If you break something, you cause it to separate into two or more pieces, often in a way that is irreparable.

words.ex: I eat bread and eggs for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃面包和鸡蛋。
words.en: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.

words.tr: n. 崩溃；故障；细目分类；
words.ex: The stress led to a breakdown.
words.ex_cn: 压力导致了崩溃。
words.en: A breakdown is a failure of a system, machine, or relationship, or a sudden collapse in someone's mental health.

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.ex: He built a wall with red bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: Bricks are rectangular blocks of baked clay used for building walls and houses.

words.ex: He nailed the wood boards to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把木板钉在墙上。
words.en: Planks of wood; a group of people who manage or direct a company or organization; the stage in a theater.

words.ex: The boats are floating on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 船在湖上漂浮。
words.en: A boat is a vehicle for travelling on water, especially one that is small enough to be carried on a ship or to float on a river or lake.

words.ex: She cares about her body shape.
words.ex_cn: 她关心自己的体型。
words.en: The natural form of a person's body, especially in terms of its overall appearance and the proportions of its parts.

words.ex: Doctors test body fluids to find diseases.
words.ex_cn: 医生检测体液以发现疾病。
words.en: Body fluids refer to the liquids that are found within the bodies of living organisms, including blood, lymph, saliva, and urine, which are essential for various physiological processes.

words.tr: phrase. 身体语言；肢体语言
words.ex: He smiles and nods, that is positive body language.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑并点头，这是积极的肢体语言。
words.en: The conscious and unconscious movements and postures by which attitudes and feelings are communicated.

words.tr: n. 预订； v. 预订；“book”的现在分词；
words.ex: I made a booking for a hotel room.
words.ex_cn: 我预订了一间酒店房间。
words.en: The act of reserving accommodations, travel arrangements, tickets, etc., in advance.

words.ex: We booked in advance to get good seats.
words.ex_cn: 我们提前预订了座位，以便得到好位置。
words.en: To arrange for something to be reserved or secured at a time before it is needed.

words.ex: He filled out the booking form for the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他填写了酒店的预订表格。
words.en: A document used to reserve or book a service, such as a hotel room or flight.

words.ex: He wore heavy boots to walk in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了厚重的靴子在雪地里走路。
words.en: Boots are a type of footwear that covers the foot and extends up the leg, sometimes to the knee or even the hip. They are typically made of leather or rubber and are worn for protection against cold, wet, or rugged terrain.

words.ex: He collects bottle tops from soda bottles.
words.ex_cn: 他收集苏打水瓶的瓶盖。
words.en: The cap or lid that seals the opening of a bottle.

words.ex: He drinks bottled water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝瓶装水。
words.en: Water that has been purified and sealed in bottles for drinking.

words.ex: The cable connects the computer to the printer.
words.ex_cn: 这条电缆将电脑连接到打印机。
words.en: A cable is a thick wire or rope, or a bundle of wires or ropes, used to carry electricity or electronic signals, or to support a structure.

words.ex: The tourists rode the cable car up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 游客们乘坐缆车上了山。
words.en: A cable car is a vehicle that is pulled by a moving cable and is used for transporting people up and down mountains.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.ex: He lost the cabin key last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚弄丢了小木屋的钥匙。
words.en: A key that unlocks the door to a cabin, typically a small wooden house or shelter.

words.tr: v. 叫；打电话； n. 打电话；“call”的复数；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上叫他的狗。
words.en: To call someone means to telephone them. To call something means to give it a particular name or description.

words.ex: He set up call diversion to another phone.
words.ex_cn: 他设置了呼叫转接至另一部电话。
words.en: Call diversion is a telecommunication feature that allows a user to redirect incoming calls to another telephone number.

words.ex: She baked three cakes for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对烤了三个蛋糕。
words.en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat.

words.ex: The camel walks slowly across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼缓慢地走过沙漠。
words.en: A camel is a large animal that lives in the desert and has one or two humps on its back.

words.tr:
n. 营地；
v. 宿营；露营；
words.ex: The children set up a camp near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边搭了一个营地。
words.en: A camp is a place where people live temporarily in tents or other temporary structures.

words.ex: We set up our tent at the campsite near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边的野营地搭了帐篷。
words.en: A campsite is a place where people who are camping can stay, often with facilities such as toilets and showers.

words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.ex: She lit the candles for a cozy dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她点燃了蜡烛，营造温馨的晚餐氛围。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a string through the middle which you burn to give light.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
words.en: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced when people and animals breathe out, or when carbon is burned in the air. It is used by plants in photosynthesis.

words.ex: He visited the career office to find a job.
words.ex_cn: 他去职业办公室找工作。
words.en: An office that provides advice and information on careers and job opportunities, often within an educational institution.

words.ex: He is holding three cards in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着三张牌。
words.en: Cards are pieces of stiff paper or thin cardboard, often with a picture on one side, which are used for playing games or for sending messages.

words.ex: He uses a card index to store phone numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用卡片索引来存储电话号码。
words.en: A card index is a system of organizing information on cards, which are stored in a box or cabinet and can be searched through easily.

words.ex: The living room has soft carpets.
words.ex_cn: 客厅里有柔软的地毯。
words.en: Carpets are thick woven materials for covering floors.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoons every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通。
words.en: Cartoons are humorous drawings or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or animated films intended for children.

words.ex: The teacher gave us two case studies to read.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们两个案例研究来阅读。
words.en: Detailed examinations of a subject of study (such as a person, group, or event) over time, especially in business, medicine, or education, to analyze its development or outcomes.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his cattle every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的牛。
words.en: Cattle are large domesticated animals that are kept on farms for their milk or meat.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.tr: n. 椅子；“chair”的复数； v. 主持；
words.ex: The students sat on the chairs in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们坐在教室的椅子上。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.tr: n. 主席；主持人；董事长；
words.ex: The chairman called the meeting to order.
words.ex_cn: 主席宣布会议开始。
words.en: A chairman is a man who is in charge of a meeting, committee, or organization.

words.ex: This store sells the cheapest apples in town.
words.ex_cn: 这家店卖城里最便宜的苹果。
words.en: The least expensive option available.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.tr: n. 清单；检查表；备忘录；目录册；
words.ex: He made a checklist for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行列了一份清单。
words.en: A checklist is a list of items required, things to be done, or points to be considered, used as a reminder.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical refers to music, literature, or art that is considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting value, especially from the ancient Greek or Roman periods or from the 18th and early 19th centuries.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical music refers to the art music produced or rooted in the traditions of Western culture, including both liturgical (religious) and secular music.

words.ex: He loves reading classical history books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读古典历史书籍。
words.en: Classical history refers to the history of the ancient Greeks and Romans, which is considered foundational to Western civilization.

words.ex: The students are sitting in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们正坐在教室里。
words.en: A room in a school where lessons take place.

words.ex: The principal gave us a classroom tour.
words.ex_cn: 校长带我们参观了教室。
words.en: A guided walk-through of a classroom, showing its layout, resources, and features.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很清楚。
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.ex: She has a clear voice when she sings.
words.ex_cn: 她唱歌时声音清晰。
words.en: A voice that is loud, distinct, and easy to hear, without mumbling or obstruction.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.tr: n. 攀爬；爬升； v. 攀爬；爬升；“climb”的现在分词；
words.ex: Climbing is his favorite outdoor activity.
words.ex_cn: 攀爬是他最喜欢的户外活动。
words.en: Climbing is the activity of climbing up something, especially mountains or rocks, often as a sport or hobby.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.tr: phrase. 客户信贷分类；信用等级
words.ex: The bank checked his credit rating before giving him a loan.
words.ex_cn: 银行在给他贷款前查看了他的客户信贷分类。
words.en: A credit rating is an evaluation of the credit risk of a prospective debtor (an individual, a business, company or a government), predicting their ability to pay back the debt, and an implicit forecast of the likelihood of the debtor defaulting.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；密集的； v. “crowd”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was crowded during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车很拥挤。
words.en: If a place is crowded, it is full of people.

words.tr: n. 教练；长途客运汽车；“coach”的复数； v. 培训；
words.ex: The coaches helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 教练们帮助球队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a sport. Coaches are also the vehicles that carry passengers over long distances.

words.ex: He wrote codes to make the app work.
words.ex_cn: 他编写了代码来让应用程序运行。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy.

words.ex: We walked along the coast and saw the sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着海岸散步，看到了大海。
words.en: The coast is the land along the edge of the sea or ocean.

words.ex: His collection of old coins is very rare.
words.ex_cn: 他收集的旧硬币非常稀有。
words.en: A collection is a group of things, often of the same type, that have been gathered together over a period of time.

words.ex: He enjoys collecting stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢收集邮票。
words.en: The act of gathering items together, especially as a hobby or for study.

words.ex: They collect money for the school trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们为学校旅行筹钱。
words.en: To gather funds, often for a specific purpose like a donation or payment.

words.ex: Many children get colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在冬天会得伤风。
words.en: Colds are mild illnesses that make you sneeze and cough a lot.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.ex: He found some coins in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他在口袋里发现了一些硬币。
words.en: Coins are small, flat, round pieces of metal used as money.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: The comparison of the two phones helped me decide.
words.ex_cn: 对这两部手机的比较帮助我做出了决定。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences or similarities between them.

words.ex: He filled out a comment card after the meal.
words.ex_cn: 他在用餐后填写了一张意见卡。
words.en: A card provided for customers or visitors to write their comments or feedback on a service or product.

words.ex: We went to two concerts last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了两场音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: They practice music in the concert room.
words.ex_cn: 他们在音乐厅里练习音乐。
words.en: A room designed for the performance of concerts, typically equipped with seating for an audience and designed with good acoustics.

words.ex: They went to the concert hall to hear the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他们去音乐厅听交响乐。
words.en: A concert hall is a building designed for the performance of concerts and other musical events.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.tr: n. 容器；集装箱；“container”的复数；
words.ex: The boxes are containers for the toys.
words.ex_cn: 这些盒子是装玩具的容器。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: She learned cookery from her grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 她向祖母学习烹调法。
words.en: Cookery is the activity or skill of preparing and cooking food.

words.ex: They cooperate to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作以按时完成项目。
words.en: If you cooperate with someone, you work with them or help them for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
adj. 合作的；
n. 合作社；
words.ex: The two companies made a cooperative effort to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司合作努力解决问题。
words.en: A cooperative is an organization or business that is owned and run jointly by its members, who share the profits or benefits.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.tr: phrase. 合作贷款；由合作社提供的贷款，通常用于支持成员的经济活动
words.ex: They took a cooperative loan to buy farm equipment.
words.ex_cn: 他们申请了一笔合作贷款来购买农具。
words.en: A cooperative loan is a type of loan provided by a cooperative organization to its members, often at favorable terms to support their economic activities.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.tr: adj. 有成本效益的；划算的
words.ex: This bike is cost-effective and saves money.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车物有所值，能省钱。
words.en: Something that is cost-effective gives the best possible profit or benefits in comparison with the money that is spent.

words.ex: He loves his country and wants to serve it.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱自己的国家，想要为它服务。
words.en: A country is a region identified as a distinct entity in political geography.

words.ex: They enjoy countryside living because it is quiet and peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢乡村生活，因为那里安静而平和。
words.en: Living in rural areas, away from cities and towns, often characterized by a simpler, more natural lifestyle.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: He finished his coursework last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周完成了他的课程作业。
words.en: Coursework refers to the work that students do during a course of study, which is often assessed as part of their final grade.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the course outline on the first day.
words.ex_cn: 老师在第一天给了我们课程大纲。
words.en: A course outline is a document that summarizes the main points of a course, including the objectives, content, and assessment methods.

words.ex: The shop welcomes many customers every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天欢迎许多顾客。
words.en: People or organizations that buy goods or services from a store or business.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车； v. 骑自行车；“cycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cycling is good for health.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车对健康有益。
words.en: Cycling is the activity of riding a bicycle, especially as a sport or for pleasure.

words.ex: There is danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 河边有危险。
words.en: Danger is the possibility that someone may be harmed or killed.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: The cat is in danger from the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫正处在大狗的危险中。
words.en: At risk of harm, injury, or loss.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间变得黑暗。
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.ex: He wears dark-coloured clothes in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿深色衣服。
words.en: Having a dark color.

words.ex: He wears a dark blue shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿一件深蓝色的衬衫。
words.en: A dark blue color is a deep shade of blue.

words.ex: He develops film in the darkroom.
words.ex_cn: 他在暗室里冲洗胶片。
words.en: A darkroom is a room from which normal light is excluded, used especially for developing photographs.

words.tr:
n. 日期；年代；约会；枣子；枣椰树；
v. 标日期；约会；追溯到；过时；
words.ex: What is the date today?
words.ex_cn: 今天是几号？
words.en: A date is a specific day of the month or year, which can be identified by a particular name or number.

words.ex: He does data analysis for his job.
words.ex_cn: 他工作做数据分析。
words.en: The process of systematically applying statistical and/or logical techniques to describe and illustrate, condense and recap, and evaluate data.

words.ex: I will see you tomorrow day.
words.ex_cn: 我明天见你。
words.en: A day is a period of twenty-four hours, especially from twelve o'clock one night to twelve o'clock the next night.

words.ex: He has a day off on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他星期五休息一天。
words.en: A day off is a day when you do not go to work or school, especially because you have a holiday or because you need or want to rest.

words.ex: The birds sing at daylight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在日光下歌唱。
words.en: Daylight is the natural light that comes from the sun during the day.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.tr: n. 装饰品；装饰物；“decoration”的复数；
words.ex: The Christmas tree has many colorful decorations.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞树上有许多五彩缤纷的装饰品。
words.en: Objects or materials used to make a place look more attractive, especially something used for a special occasion or celebration.

words.ex: The team improved its defense in the second half.
words.ex_cn: 球队在下半场改进了防守。
words.en: The act of defending against attack, danger, or injury.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.tr: n. 设计者；构思者；“designer”的复数；
words.ex: The designers created a new dress for the fashion show.
words.ex_cn: 这些设计者为时装秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: Designers are people who plan the look or workings of something prior to it being made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.ex: He does design research to understand user needs.
words.ex_cn: 他做设计研究来了解用户需求。
words.en: Design research is a study of the process of designing, often with the aim of improving design practices and outcomes.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: The department head speaks to the teachers every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 系主任每周一和老师们谈话。
words.en: A department head is a person who is in charge of a department within an organization or company.

words.tr: phrase. 百货商店；百货公司
words.ex: She bought a dress at the department store.
words.ex_cn: 她在百货商店买了一条裙子。
words.en: A large shop divided into several different areas, each of which sells different types of goods.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: The developing country is building new schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个发展中国家正在建设新的学校。
words.en: A developing country is a country with a less developed industrial base and a low Human Development Index (HDI) relative to other countries.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: She writes in her diaries every night.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book which has a separate space for each day of the year. You use a diary to write down things you plan to do, or to record what happens in your life day by day.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
