words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.ex: He cares about his digital privacy online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上关心自己的数字隐私。
words.en: The protection of personal information and data in the digital environment.

words.ex: The digital system shows the time on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 这个数字系统在屏幕上显示时间。
words.en: A digital system is a system that uses discrete values, often binary numbers, for input, processing, transmission, storage, or display, as opposed to an analog system which uses continuous signals.

words.tr: phrase. 数字商店；数字存储
words.ex: He bought a book from a digital store.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个数字商店买了一本书。
words.en: A digital store is an online platform where goods or services are sold over the internet.

words.ex: We have dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天晚上7点吃晚餐。
words.en: The main meal of the day, eaten in the evening or at midday.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.tr:
adj. 直接的；
v. 指导；指示；
words.ex: He gave a direct answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了直接的答案。
words.en: If you direct something at a particular thing, you aim or point it at that thing.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.ex: He put on his diving mask before jumping into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他跳入海里前戴上了潜水镜。
words.en: A piece of equipment worn over the eyes and nose to enable a person to see clearly underwater.

words.ex: The clothes are drying in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 衣服正在阳光下变干。
words.en: The process of removing moisture from something.

words.tr: adj. 干的；干燥的； v. 变干；“dry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She ate dried fruit for a snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃干果当零食。
words.en: If something is dried, it has had all the moisture removed from it, often to preserve it.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: He plays the drums in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: Drums are musical instruments that you play by hitting them with sticks or your hands.

words.tr: n. 文件；公文；文献；“document”的复数；
words.ex: He filed all the documents in the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有文件都放在抽屉里了。
words.en: Documents are written, drawn, or printed materials that provide information or evidence.

words.ex: He submitted the documentation for his project.
words.ex_cn: 他提交了项目的文件。
words.en: Documentation refers to the act of providing documents or the documents themselves, which serve as evidence or records of something.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.ex: The school received many donations from local businesses.
words.ex_cn: 学校收到了许多来自当地企业的捐献。
words.en: Gifts of money or goods to a charitable organization or cause.

words.ex: The bike ride is easy because it is downhill.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车很容易，因为是下山的。
words.en: If something or someone is moving downhill or is downhill, they are moving down a slope or are towards the bottom of a hill.

words.ex: He closed the door quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地关上了门。
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.ex: He sells cookies door to door.
words.ex_cn: 他挨家挨户卖饼干。
words.en: If someone goes door to door, they go along a street calling at each house in turn, for example selling something.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.ex: His eating patterns changed after he moved to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后，饮食习惯发生了变化。
words.en: Eating patterns refer to the habitual way in which a person or group eats, including the types of food chosen, the timing of meals, and the quantities consumed.

words.tr:
adj. 早的；早前的；
adv. 提早地；
words.ex: He woke up early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上起得很早。
words.en: Before the usual or expected time; at or near the beginning of a particular period or series of events.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.ex: He studied economics history at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习经济史。
words.en: Economics history is the study of economies or economic phenomena of the past. Analysis in economic history is undertaken using a combination of historical methods, statistical methods, and the application of economic theory to historical situations and institutions.

words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.ex: She bought three eggs at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了三个蛋。
words.en: Eggs are oval objects that are produced by a female bird and which contain a baby bird. Chickens' eggs are often eaten as food.

words.ex: He called an emergency doctor when he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到不舒服时，他叫了急诊医生。
words.en: An emergency is an unexpected and usually dangerous situation that calls for immediate action.

words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.ex: He gave an emotional speech about his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于他母亲的感人演讲。
words.en: Something that is emotional is connected with people's feelings. If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly, especially because they are upset.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: He works in the entertainment industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在娱乐行业工作。
words.en: The sector of the economy that provides entertainment, including movies, music, television, and live performances.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.ex: He wrote three short essays about his travels.
words.ex_cn: 他写了三篇关于他旅行的短随笔。
words.en: A short piece of writing on a particular subject, often expressing personal views.

words.ex: He practices essay writing every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上练习写作文。
words.en: The activity or skill of writing essays, especially as part of a student's academic work.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: We walk in the park on evenings.
words.ex_cn: 我们在夜晚去公园散步。
words.en: The period of time at the end of the day, usually from about 6 p.m. to bedtime.

words.ex: We eat evening meals together as a family.
words.ex_cn: 我们一家人一起吃晚饭。
words.en: The main meal of the day, eaten in the evening.

words.ex: He watches the evening news every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看晚间新闻。
words.en: The evening news is a television or radio broadcast of news reports that occurs in the evening.

words.tr:
adj. 额外的；
n. 额外的事物；
adv. 额外地；
words.ex: He did extra work to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他做了额外的工作来赚更多的钱。
words.en: If something is extra, it is added to an existing amount or number.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.ex: The exhibitor showed new toys at the fair.
words.ex_cn: 参展商在展会上展示了新玩具。
words.en: An exhibitor is a person or company that shows something such as products or works of art to the public, especially at a trade fair or an art gallery.

words.ex: The city has many factories that make cars.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有许多制造汽车的工厂。
words.en: Factories are buildings or groups of buildings where goods are manufactured or assembled chiefly by machine.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.tr:
n. 害怕；惧怕；
v. 害怕；惧怕；
words.ex: He felt a deep fear when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，感到深深的害怕。
words.en: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

words.ex: The school charges small fees for books.
words.ex_cn: 学校对书籍收取少量费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something.

words.ex: Farmers use fertilizers to help crops grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用肥料来帮助庄稼生长。
words.en: Substances added to soil to improve its fertility and promote plant growth.

words.tr: n. 航班；飞行；（阶梯的）一段；
words.ex: The flight to Beijing leaves at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 飞往北京的航班早上8点起飞。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, usually in an aircraft.

words.ex: The children are playing on the floors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地板上玩耍。
words.en: The floors of a building are the different levels of it.

words.tr: n. 田野；领域；场地；“field”的复数；
words.ex: The children play in the fields after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在田野里玩耍。
words.en: Open areas of land, often used for farming, sports, or as a natural landscape.

words.tr: n. 野外考察；实地调查；
words.ex: The students went on fieldwork to collect soil samples.
words.ex_cn: 学生们去野外考察以采集土壤样本。
words.en: Fieldwork refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.ex: He wrote the first draft of his essay last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚写了论文的初稿。
words.en: The initial version of a piece of writing, which is usually revised and improved before being finalized.

words.ex: First-year students are learning basic math.
words.ex_cn: 一年级学生正在学习基础数学。
words.en: Students who are in their first year of study at a college or university.

words.ex: He keeps a first-aid kit in his car.
words.ex_cn: 他把急救包放在车里。
words.en: A first-aid kit is a collection of supplies and equipment that is used to give medical treatment.

words.ex: Regular exercise improves your fitness.
words.ex_cn: 规律锻炼能改善你的健康。
words.en: The condition of being physically fit and healthy.

words.tr: phrase. 健身水平；体能状况
words.ex: His fitness level improved after running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步后，体能水平提高了。
words.en: The degree to which someone is physically fit and healthy.

words.ex: He goes to the fitness centre every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身中心。
words.en: A fitness centre is a place where people go to do physical exercise and keep fit, often equipped with various gym equipment.

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: He eats fruits every day for health.
words.ex_cn: 他为了健康每天吃水果。
words.en: The edible product of a plant or tree, consisting of the seed and its envelope, especially the latter when it is juicy or pulpy.

words.ex: He drinks fruit juice every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝果汁。
words.en: A drink made from the liquid obtained from fruits.

words.ex: The fruit tree grows apples in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这棵果树在春天结苹果。
words.en: A tree that bears fruit, especially one grown for its edible fruits.

words.ex: She baked a fruit cake for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对烤了一个水果蛋糕。
words.en: A cake containing dried or candied fruit, nuts, etc.

words.ex: The frogs jump near the pond.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙在池塘边跳跃。
words.en: Frogs are small, tailless amphibians with a short body, protruding eyes, and the ability to leap.

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.ex: They walk in the formal garden every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上都在规整的花园里散步。
words.en: A formal garden is a garden designed in a regular, geometric pattern, often with symmetrical features and a structured layout, typically found in the grounds of large houses or estates.

words.ex: He wears formal clothing to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿正装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Clothing that is suitable for formal occasions, such as business meetings, weddings, or formal dinners.

words.ex: They have formal meetings every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周一都有正式会议。
words.en: Formal meetings are scheduled gatherings that follow a predetermined agenda and protocol, often involving key decision-makers within an organization.

words.ex: My feet hurt after walking all day.
words.ex_cn: 我走了一整天，脚很疼。
words.en: The plural of foot, which is the lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks. Also, a unit of linear measure equal to 12 inches (30.48 cm).

words.ex: The villagers walk across footbridges to reach the market.
words.ex_cn: 村民们走过人行桥去市场。
words.en: A footbridge is a bridge designed for pedestrians and sometimes cyclists, animal traffic, and equestrians, rather than vehicular traffic.

words.ex: The child left footprints in the wet sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在湿沙地上留下了脚印。
words.en: The marks left by a person's or animal's foot on a surface.

words.tr: adj. 全部时间的；专任的
words.ex: He works full-time at a grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家杂货店全职工作。
words.en: If you are a full-time worker, you work the normal number of hours or days in a week.

words.ex: Children love playing games after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢放学后玩游戏。
words.en: Games are activities or sports that involve skill, chance, or endurance on the part of two or more persons who play according to a set of rules, usually for their own amusement or for that of spectators.

words.ex: I am in game room 631.
words.ex_cn: 我在631号游戏室。
words.en: A room designated for playing games, especially video games or board games.

words.tr: n. 气体；气态；汽油；天然气；煤气；
words.ex: Oxygen is a gas that we need to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 氧气是一种我们呼吸所需的气体。
words.en: Gas is a substance like air that is neither liquid nor solid and burns easily. It is used as a fuel for cooking and heating.

words.ex: The trucks have big gas tanks.
words.ex_cn: 这些卡车有大油箱。
words.en: Containers designed to store gases under pressure or at atmospheric pressure.

words.ex: There are gaps between the bricks.
words.ex_cn: 砖块之间有空隙。
words.en: A gap is a space between two things or a hole in the middle of something solid.

words.ex: He has a gene that makes him tall.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个让他长高的基因。
words.en: A gene is the basic physical and functional unit of heredity. Genes, which are made up of DNA, act as instructions to make molecules called proteins.

words.ex: The scientist studied genetic traits in plants.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了植物的基因特征。
words.en: relating to genes or heredity

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.tr:
adj. 一般的；普遍的；总的；大致的；首席的；
n. 将军；
words.ex: He gave a general answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个一般的回答。
words.en: A general is a high-ranking officer in the army or air force. In other contexts, general refers to something that is common, usual, or not specific.

words.ex: We had a general discussion about the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们对这个项目进行了全面的讨论。
words.en: A general discussion is a conversation or debate about a topic that covers a wide range of issues or aspects, without focusing on specific details.

words.ex: He took a general tour of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他参观了这个城市的概况。
words.en: A general tour is an overview or summary of a place or subject, providing a broad understanding without going into detail.

words.ex: She gave her friends gifts on Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 她在圣诞节给了朋友们礼物。
words.en: A gift is something that you give someone as a present.

words.tr:
n. 金；金币；金黄色；
adj. 金色的；
words.ex: He bought a gold ring for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为妻子买了一枚金戒指。
words.en: Gold is a valuable, yellow-colored metal that is used for making jewelry and as an international currency.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.tr: phrase. 高尔夫球场；供打高尔夫球用的场地
words.ex: He plays golf at the golf course every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末在高尔夫球场打高尔夫。
words.en: A golf course is an area of land where the game of golf is played.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.ex: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和大米等谷物。
words.en: A grain is a small, hard seed of a food plant such as wheat, rice, or corn, or the plant itself.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，树叶是绿色的。
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.ex: He pressed the green button to start the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他按下了绿色按钮来启动机器。
words.en: A green button is a button that is green in color, often used in machines or devices to start or initiate a function.

words.ex: The city collects green waste every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 城市每周五收集绿色废弃物。
words.en: Green waste refers to organic waste that can be composted, such as garden waste, food waste, and plant material.

words.ex: The government introduced a green tax to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府征收了一项环保税以减少污染。
words.en: A green tax is a tax levied on activities that are harmful to the environment, aimed at encouraging businesses and individuals to adopt more environmentally friendly practices.

words.ex: The guest arrived at the party early.
words.ex_cn: 客人早早到了派对。
words.en: A guest is someone who is visiting a place or attending an event by invitation, without having a permanent role there.

words.ex: The policeman held a gun.
words.ex_cn: 警察拿着一把枪。
words.en: A gun is a weapon designed to discharge projectiles, often metal bullets, by the force of an explosive such as gunpowder.

words.ex: She brushed her hairs before going out.
words.ex_cn: 她出门前梳了梳头发。
words.en: Hairs are the fine thread-like strands that grow from the skin of humans and animals, especially on the head.

words.ex: The hairdresser cut my hair nicely.
words.ex_cn: 理发师给我剪了一头漂亮的头发。
words.en: A hairdresser is a person who cuts, colours, and arranges people's hair, especially women's, as their job.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题很难。
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.tr: adj. 勤勉的；努力工作的
words.ex: He is hard-working and always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他很勤奋，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is hard-working always puts a lot of effort and care into their work.

words.tr:
n. 伤害；损害；
v. 伤害；损害；
words.ex: The storm caused great harm to the crops.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对庄稼造成了很大伤害。
words.en: To harm someone or something means to cause them physical injury or to damage them in some other way.

words.ex: Smoking is harmful to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is harmful has a bad effect on something else, especially on a person's health.

words.tr:
n. 收获；收成；
v. 收获；收割；
words.ex: The farmers celebrated the harvest in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在秋天庆祝收获。
words.en: The harvest is the process of gathering mature crops from the fields. It is a crucial activity in agriculture that marks the end of the growing season.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.tr:
v. 处理；操纵；
n. 把手；柄；
words.ex: He can handle difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理难题。
words.en: To deal with or control a situation or problem.

words.tr: n. 印刷品；讲义；施舍物；救济品；“handout”的复数；
words.ex: The teacher gave out handouts for the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师发了这节课的印刷品。
words.en: Handouts are papers containing information or tasks that are given to people, especially students, to help them learn or understand something.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handbook for the science project.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们发了一本科学项目的手册。
words.en: A handbook is a type of reference work, or other collection of instructions, that is intended to provide ready reference.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.tr: n. 头痛；令人头痛的人（或事物）；
words.ex: He got a headache after working too long.
words.ex_cn: 他工作太长时间后得了头痛。
words.en: A headache is a pain in your head. If you say that something is a headache, you mean that it causes you difficulty or worry.

words.ex: The head office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a business or organization, where the most important decisions are made.

words.ex: He listens to music with headphones.
words.ex_cn: 他用耳机听音乐。
words.en: Headphones are a pair of small speakers that you wear over your ears in order to listen to music or other sounds without other people hearing them.

words.tr: n. 听力；听觉； v. 听；听见；“hear”的现在分词；
words.ex: His hearing is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的听力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: The ability to perceive sounds; a session in which evidence and arguments are presented to a court or committee.

words.ex: The box is heavy.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子很重。
words.en: Something that is heavy weighs a lot.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: He wears a helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴头盔。
words.en: A helmet is a strong, hard hat which is worn to protect your head.

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这座山很高。
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.ex: The metal melts at high temperature.
words.ex_cn: 金属在高温下熔化。
words.en: A high temperature is a condition where the temperature is significantly above the normal range.

words.ex: He pays high car taxes every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年都要支付很高的汽车税。
words.en: High car taxes refer to the significant amount of money that car owners are required to pay to the government as a tax for owning and operating a vehicle, often implemented to discourage car use or to fund public transportation projects.

words.ex: He eats a high energy snack after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后吃一份高能量零食。
words.en: A food item that provides a quick boost of energy, often high in carbohydrates or sugar.

words.ex: The car drove fast on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在高速公路上开得很快。
words.en: A highway is a main road, especially one that connects towns or cities.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.ex: He found old historical maps in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆找到了旧的历史地图。
words.en: Maps that depict places, boundaries, or events from past eras, used for study or reference.

words.ex: He found an old historical photograph in his attic.
words.ex_cn: 他在阁楼上发现了一张旧的历史照片。
words.en: A photograph that captures or represents a moment, event, or scene from the past, often used for educational or archival purposes.

words.ex: We go to the beach during holidays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去海滩。
words.en: Holidays are days when people do not go to work or school, especially because of a religious or national celebration.

words.tr:
n. 家；家庭；
adv. 在家；
adj. 家的；家庭的；
words.ex: I love to go home after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后喜欢回家。
words.en: The place where one lives permanently, especially as a member of a family or household.

words.ex: He still uses his home phone to call his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然用家里的电话给父母打电话。
words.en: A home phone is a telephone that is located in a person's home, as opposed to a mobile phone or a work phone.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.ex: Many hospitals are busy during winter.
words.ex_cn: 许多医院在冬天都很忙。
words.en: A hospital is an institution where sick or injured people are given medical or surgical care.

words.ex: Many tourists stay in hotels near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 许多游客住在靠近海滩的酒店里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.tr: n. 打猎；寻找； v. “hunt”的现在分词；
words.ex: Hunting is popular in some rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 打猎在一些农村地区很流行。
words.en: The activity of chasing and killing wild animals and birds for food or sport.

words.ex: Humans need water to survive.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要水来生存。
words.en: Human beings collectively; the human race.

words.ex: The lake is covered with ice in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天湖面结满了冰。
words.en: Ice is frozen water. It is a solid state of water that occurs when water freezes at or below 0 degrees Celsius.

words.ex: He put an ice pack on his knee after the injury.
words.ex_cn: 他在膝盖受伤后敷了一个冰袋。
words.en: A bag filled with ice or a gel that can be frozen, used to cool an injury or to keep food cold.

words.ex: He shared some good ideas for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他为这个项目分享了一些好主意。
words.en: Thoughts or suggestions as to a possible course of action.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.ex: He showed me his images from the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他旅行时拍的照片。
words.en: Pictures or photographs, especially those created electronically.

words.ex: There was a big improvement in his English skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平有了很大改进。
words.en: The act of making something better or the state of being made better; an example or instance of this.

words.ex: It is impossible to finish the race in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 五分钟内完成比赛是不可能的。
words.en: If something is impossible, it cannot be done or cannot happen.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.ex: He spilled ink on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他把墨水洒在了衬衫上。
words.en: Ink is the colored liquid used for writing, printing, or drawing.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.ex: The bank raised interest rates last month.
words.ex_cn: 银行上个月提高了利率。
words.en: The cost of borrowing money or the return for lending money, typically expressed as an annual percentage of the principal.

words.ex: The internal parts of the machine need repair.
words.ex_cn: 机器的内部零件需要修理。
words.en: Internal is used to describe things that exist or happen inside a particular person, object, or place.

words.ex: The bird knows when to fly south by its internal clock.
words.ex_cn: 鸟通过它的生物钟知道何时飞往南方。
words.en: An internal clock is a natural mechanism within living organisms that regulates the timing of physiological processes and behaviors, such as sleep cycles, in accordance with the environment.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.tr: n. 物品；商品；项目；条款；“item”的复数；
words.ex: These items are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 这些物品在桌子上。
words.en: Objects or articles that are used for a particular purpose or are present in a situation.

words.ex: He put on his jacket before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了夹克。
words.en: A jacket is a short coat with long sleeves.

words.ex: He wears blue jeans every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤。
words.en: Jeans are casual trousers made from denim or dungaree cloth.

words.tr:
adj. 联合的；共同的；
n. 关节；接合处；
words.ex: They signed a joint agreement to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一项联合协议来保护环境。
words.en: A joint is a place where two things are joined together, especially the place where two bones are connected in a person's or animal's body.

words.tr: v. 加入；连结；“join”的现在分词； n. 连接；
words.ex: He is joining the club next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要加入这个俱乐部。
words.en: To become a member of a group or organization; to connect or fasten things together.

words.ex: The club has low joining fees for new members.
words.ex_cn: 该俱乐部对新成员收取的入会费很低。
words.en: The amount of money that you have to pay to become a member of a club, organization, or society.

words.ex: He reads science journals every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都读科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a magazine, especially one that deals with a specialized subject, or a daily record of events or business.

words.tr:
adj. 关键的；
n. 钥匙；关键；
words.ex: This is a key step to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决问题的关键步骤。
words.en: A key is a specially shaped piece of metal that you place in a lock and turn in order to open or lock a door, or to start or stop the engine of a vehicle.

words.ex: He types fast on the keyboard.
words.ex_cn: 他打字很快，用的是键盘。
words.en: A keyboard is a panel of keys that operate a computer or typewriter.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the head of state of that country.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.ex: They practice knowledge sharing every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周进行知识共享。
words.en: The act of sharing information, skills, or expertise among people or organizations to enhance learning and innovation.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室做实验。
words.en: A lab is a place where scientific experiments and research are conducted.

words.ex: The students work in laboratories to test science experiments.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室里做科学实验。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific experiments, research, or teaching, or for the manufacture of drugs or chemicals.

words.ex: The students submitted their laboratories report after the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验后提交了他们的实验室报告。
words.en: A written account or document detailing findings, experiments, or observations from a laboratory.

words.ex: He speaks three languages fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他能流利地说三种语言。
words.en: Languages refer to the system of communication used by a particular community or country, consisting of words used in a structured and conventional way and conveyed by speech, writing, or gesture.

words.ex: He has a large house.
words.ex_cn: 他有一所大房子。
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.ex: He works in a large office.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个大的办公室工作。
words.en: A large office refers to a spacious or extensive workspace designed to accommodate many employees or a significant amount of work.

words.ex: The company built a large scale factory to make more products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司建造了一个大规模的工厂来生产更多产品。
words.en: Involving or affecting a large number of people or things; extensive.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.ex: He is a leader who helps his team succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助团队取得成功的领袖。
words.en: A leader is the person in charge of a group, organization, or country, who makes decisions and ensures that things are done effectively.

words.tr: n. 领导才能；领导地位；
words.ex: His leadership helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 他的领导才能帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: Leadership is the ability to lead, guide, or direct a group, organization, or country.

words.ex: His leadership style is calm and fair.
words.ex_cn: 他的领导风格冷静而公正。
words.en: A leadership style refers to a leader's methods and behaviors when directing, motivating, and managing others.

words.tr: n. 叶；叶片；“leaf”的复数； v. 留下；离开；离去；
words.ex: The tree loses its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: Leaves are the main organs of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants, usually green and flat, attached to the stems or branches. As a verb, it is the third person singular present tense of 'leave', meaning to go away from a place.

words.ex: He handed out a leaflet about the event.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一份关于该活动的传单。
words.en: A leaflet is a small sheet of printed paper that gives you information or advertises something.

words.ex: I learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天学习英语。
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.tr: n. 学习；学问； v. 学习；“learn”的现在分词；
words.ex: Learning takes time and practice.
words.ex_cn: 学习需要时间和练习。
words.en: The acquisition of knowledge or skills through study, experience, or being taught.

words.tr: phrase. 学习障碍；学习困难
words.ex: Some children have a learning difficulty and need extra help in school.
words.ex_cn: 一些孩子有学习困难，需要在学校得到额外帮助。
words.en: A learning difficulty is a condition that makes it harder for someone to learn in the same way as most other people.

words.ex: The teacher created a quiet learning zone for students to focus.
words.ex_cn: 老师创建了一个安静的学习区，让学生们专心学习。
words.en: An area designated for the purpose of studying or acquiring knowledge, often characterized by resources and an environment conducive to learning.

words.ex: He knows his learning style is visual.
words.ex_cn: 他知道自己的学习方式是视觉型的。
words.en: A learning style is the method of learning particular to an individual that is presumed to allow that individual to learn best.

words.ex: The learner practices English every day.
words.ex_cn: 这位学习者每天练习英语。
words.en: A learner is someone who is learning a particular subject or skill.

words.ex: He attends three lectures every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周上三节讲课。
words.en: Lectures are talks that are given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.tr: n. 水平；等级；级别；层次；“level”的复数；
words.ex: The levels of noise in the room were too high.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的噪音水平太高了。
words.en: Levels refer to the height of something or the position of something in a scale of quantity or quality.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: He got a driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A license is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.tr: phrase. 人寿保险；人身保险
words.ex: He bought life insurance for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他为家人买了人寿保险。
words.en: Life insurance is a contract between an insurance policy holder and an insurer, where the insurer promises to pay a designated beneficiary a sum of money in exchange for a premium, upon the death of an insured person.

words.tr: n. 寿命；使用寿命；生命期；
words.ex: The lifespan of a housefly is only a few weeks.
words.ex_cn: 家蝇的寿命只有几周。
words.en: The length of time for which a person or animal lives or a thing functions.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.tr: phrase. 生活周期；存在周期
words.ex: The life cycle of a butterfly includes egg, larva, pupa, and adult.
words.ex_cn: 蝴蝶的生活周期包括卵、幼虫、蛹和成虫。
words.en: The series of changes that a living thing goes through from the beginning of its life until death.

words.tr: n. 举起；上升；吊起； v. 举起；抬起；提起；“lift”的现在分词；
words.ex: The lifting of the box made his back hurt.
words.ex_cn: 举起这个箱子使他的背部很疼。
words.en: The act of raising something to a higher position or level.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.tr: n. 倾听；收听； v. 听；“listen”的现在分词；
words.ex: Good listening helps you understand others.
words.ex_cn: 良好的倾听能帮助你理解他人。
words.en: The act of paying attention to and trying to hear something.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.tr: adj. 活着的； n. 生活；生计； v. 生活；“live”的现在分词；
words.ex: The living animals need water and food.
words.ex_cn: 活着的动物需要水和食物。
words.en: The state of being alive; the experience of being alive; a particular way or style of life.

words.ex: He works part-time to pay for his living expense.
words.ex_cn: 他做兼职来支付他的生活费。
words.en: The amount of money that is needed to pay for the things that you need to live, such as food, housing, and clothing.

words.ex: They sat at long tables in the cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 他们坐在食堂的长桌旁。
words.en: Long, rectangular tables, often used in classrooms, dining halls, or for group work.

words.ex: He chose a low-risk investment to save for retirement.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了一种低风险投资来为退休储蓄。
words.en: An investment that is considered to have a minimal chance of losing the principal or the invested amount.

words.ex: The child has low nutrition because he eats few vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子营养不良，因为他吃很少的蔬菜。
words.en: A state where the body does not receive enough nutrients to maintain health.

words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.ex: I eat lunch at noon every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天中午吃午餐。
words.en: A meal eaten in the middle of the day, typically one that is lighter or less formal than an evening meal.

words.ex: The factory has many machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂里有许多机器。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.tr: n. 机械（总称）；机械装置；
words.ex: The factory uses old machinery to produce goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用旧机械来生产产品。
words.en: Machinery refers to machines in general or the parts of a machine that make it work.

words.ex: He showed maturity when he apologized for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 当他为自己的错误道歉时，表现出了成熟。
words.en: Maturity is the state of being fully developed or grown, or the time when a financial arrangement becomes ready to be paid.

words.tr:
adj. 男性的；雄性的；
n. 男性；雄性；
words.ex: The male bird has bright red feathers.
words.ex_cn: 这只雄鸟有鲜艳的红色羽毛。
words.en: A male is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that cannot have babies. In humans, males are usually considered to be boys or men.

words.ex: The school has equal numbers of male and female students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校男女学生人数相等。
words.en: A phrase referring to both male and female individuals, often used to describe gender inclusivity or a mixed group.

words.ex: The main reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The most important part or aspect of something.

words.ex: The children are playing in the main hall.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在主厅里玩耍。
words.en: The principal or largest room in a building, used for gatherings or events.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉。
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.tr: n. 一餐；一顿饭；“meal”的复数；
words.ex: We eat three meals a day.
words.ex_cn: 我们一天吃三餐。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: We have meetings every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周一都有会议。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.ex: I look at old photos to remember my childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 我看着老照片来回忆我的童年记忆。
words.en: Memories are things that you remember about the past.

words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.ex: He shows strong mental ability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很强的思维能力。
words.en: The capacity of an individual to perform the higher mental processes of reasoning, remembering, understanding, and problem solving.

words.ex: Iron and copper are common metals.
words.ex_cn: 铁和铜是常见的金属。
words.en: Metals are chemical elements that are typically hard, shiny, malleable, fusible, and ductile, with good electrical and thermal conductivity.

words.ex: Birds migrate south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天迁徙到南方。
words.en: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

words.ex: He drinks a glass of milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
words.en: Milk is a white liquid produced by cows, goats, and some other animals, which people drink and use in cooking.

words.tr: n. 小巴；小型公共汽车；
words.ex: The children took the minibus to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐小巴去学校。
words.en: A minibus is a small bus, usually one that carries fewer than twenty passengers.

words.ex: They drive a minivan to take the kids to school.
words.ex_cn: 他们开一辆小型货车送孩子们上学。
words.en: A minivan is a vehicle designed for carrying passengers, which is smaller than a full-size van but larger than a compact car.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.ex: He uses a mobile phone to call his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机给朋友打电话。
words.en: A mobile phone is a telephone that you can carry with you and use to make or receive calls wherever you are.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: He learns modern language at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习现代语言。
words.en: A modern language is a language that is currently in use in a country or region, as opposed to ancient languages which are no longer spoken.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: He learns money management from his dad.
words.ex_cn: 他从他爸爸那里学习理财。
words.en: Money management refers to the process of budgeting, saving, investing, spending or otherwise overseeing the capital usage of an individual or group.

words.ex: The monkeys are climbing the trees.
words.ex_cn: 猴子们正在爬树。
words.en: Monkeys are mammals of the order Primates, which includes lemurs, lorises, tarsiers, and apes, including humans. They are known for their intelligence and social behavior.

words.ex: I drink coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早晨喝咖啡。
words.en: The morning is the part of each day between the time that people usually wake up and the time they start work or school, or the part of the day before noon.

words.tr: n. 姓名；名称；“name”的复数； v. 说出…的名字；
words.ex: He wrote down the names of all the students.
words.ex_cn: 他写下了所有学生的姓名。
words.en: A name is a word or set of words by which a person, animal, place, or thing is known, addressed, or referred to.

words.ex: The ship uses navigational tools to find its way.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用航行工具来确定方向。
words.en: Relating to the process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: The drug has a negative effect on his health.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物对他的健康有负面影响。
words.en: A negative effect is an adverse or unfavorable outcome or impact that results from a particular action, event, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 负面想法；消极思想
words.ex: He keeps having negative thinking about his future.
words.ex_cn: 他总是对未来有消极的想法。
words.en: Negative thinking refers to a mental attitude in which one expects the worst possible outcomes or focuses on the negative aspects of a situation.

words.ex: Scientists counted 777 nests in the area.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在该区域数出了777个巢穴。
words.en: A nest is a structure built by birds or other animals to hold their eggs and provide a safe environment for their offspring. As a verb, to nest means to build or occupy a nest.

words.ex: Birds begin nesting in spring.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在春天开始筑巢。
words.en: The process by which birds build or occupy nests.

words.ex: The fisherman mended his nets by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫在海边修补他的网。
words.en: Nets are devices made from threads or ropes that are woven together, used for catching fish or other animals, or for various other purposes such as in sports or to protect against insects.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: The stars are bright at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚星星很亮。
words.en: The period of darkness in each twenty-four hours; the time from sunset to sunrise.

words.ex: We went on a night tour of the city.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了城市的夜间游览。
words.en: A guided visit or trip around a place, especially one conducted in the evening or at night, often to see sights that are particularly impressive or beautiful when illuminated.

words.ex: He works night shifts at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上夜班。
words.en: Periods of work during the night, typically in a job that requires 24-hour coverage.

words.ex: None of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 没有一个学生通过了考试。
words.en: not any; no amount or part of something

words.ex: This is a non-smoking room.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个无烟房间。
words.en: Non-smoking refers to areas or policies where smoking is not allowed.

words.tr: adj. 非原生的；非本地的
words.ex: He is a non-native speaker of English.
words.ex_cn: 他不是英语母语者。
words.en: A non-native person or thing is one that does not originate from or is not indigenous to a particular place.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: His objectives are to learn English and find a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是学好英语并找到一份好工作。
words.en: An objective is something you plan to achieve, especially in business or politics.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: The ocean is very big and deep.
words.ex_cn: 海洋非常大且深。
words.en: The vast body of salt water that covers almost three quarters of the earth's surface.

words.ex: The ocean condition affects fish migration.
words.ex_cn: 海洋条件影响鱼类的迁徙。
words.en: The state or quality of the ocean, including factors such as temperature, salinity, wave height, and current strength, which can affect marine life and human activities at sea.

words.ex: Ocean currents move warm water across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 洋流将暖水输送到海洋各处。
words.en: Ocean currents are the continuous, directed movement of seawater generated by forces acting upon this mean flow, such as breaking waves, wind, the Coriolis effect, cabbeling, and temperature and salinity differences.

words.tr: adj. 最老的；最旧的；最年老的；
words.ex: He is the oldest person in his family.
words.ex_cn: 他是家里最年长的人。
words.en: The superlative form of 'old', used to describe someone or something that is the most aged or has existed the longest among a group.

words.ex: He wears old clothes to paint his house.
words.ex_cn: 他穿旧衣服来粉刷房子。
words.en: Clothes that are no longer new or fashionable, often considered to be worn out or outdated.

words.tr:
adv. 在网上地；在线地；
adj. 联机的；在线的；
words.ex: He works online from home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家网上工作。
words.en: Connected to or available through a computer network, especially the Internet.

words.ex: He likes online shopping for clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在网上买衣服。
words.en: The activity of buying goods or services over the internet.

words.ex: He plays an online game every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上玩一款在线游戏。
words.en: An online game is a video game that is either partially or primarily played through the Internet or any other computer network available.

words.ex: He uses an online service to pay his bills.
words.ex_cn: 他使用在线服务支付账单。
words.en: An online service is a service that is available on the internet.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.ex: They went to the opera house last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚去了歌剧院。
words.en: An opera house is a theatre building used for performances of opera.

words.tr:
adj. 开放的；营业的；
v. 打开；开放；
n. 公开；户外；
words.ex: The park is open to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对所有人开放。
words.en: If you open something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, you move it so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.ex: He looks for new opportunities every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在寻找新的机会。
words.en: A time or set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.tr:
n. 橙子；橙色；
adj. 橙色的；
words.ex: I ate an orange for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃了一个橙子。
words.en: A round juicy citrus fruit with a tough bright reddish-yellow rind.

words.ex: He overfilled the cup with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子装得水都溢出来了。
words.en: To fill something beyond its capacity or beyond what is necessary.

words.ex: He returned the overdue books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他把逾期的书还给了图书馆。
words.en: Books that have not been returned by the due date.

words.ex: Overfishing is hurting the ocean fish.
words.ex_cn: 过度捕捞正在伤害海洋中的鱼类。
words.en: The act of catching too many fish at once, so that the fish population becomes too low to recover.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.ex: My leg is paining after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 我摔倒后腿很疼。
words.en: If something pains you, it makes you feel upset and distressed.

words.ex: He took a painkiller for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一片止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: A painkiller is a drug that reduces or removes physical pain.

words.ex: The painter draws a beautiful house.
words.ex_cn: 这位画家画了一座美丽的房子。
words.en: A painter is someone who paints pictures, or someone whose job is to paint surfaces such as walls and doors.

words.tr: n. 绘画；油画； v. 刷油漆；用颜料画；“paint”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves painting in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间绘画。
words.en: A painting is a picture which someone has painted.

words.ex: He attends a painting class every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六都去上绘画课。
words.en: A scheduled session where participants learn techniques and skills related to creating visual art, typically using paints and brushes.

words.ex: My parents go to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母每天早上去上班。
words.en: Your parents are your mother and father.

words.ex: We went to three parties last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去了三个派对。
words.en: A party is a social gathering of invited guests, typically involving eating, drinking, and entertainment.

words.ex: The children wore party hats at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在生日派对上戴了派对帽。
words.en: Hats worn at parties, often colorful and decorative, to enhance the festive atmosphere.

words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: If you pay attention to someone or something, you watch, listen to, or think about them carefully.

words.ex: He paid in cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: To pay for goods or services using physical money rather than a credit card or other forms of payment.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.ex: He bought three new pens for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了三支新笔。
words.en: A pen is an instrument for writing or drawing with ink, typically consisting of a metal nib or ball, or a nylon tip, fitted into a metal or plastic holder.

words.ex: The children are holding their pencils.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们拿着他们的铅笔。
words.en: Pencils are instruments for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of graphite or a similar substance enclosed in a cylinder of wood or fixed in a metal or plastic case.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.ex: My pets are a cat and a dog.
words.ex_cn: 我的宠物是一只猫和一只狗。
words.en: Animals kept for companionship or pleasure.

words.ex: Some people eat pet meat, but it is illegal in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 有些人吃宠物肉，但在许多国家这是非法的。
words.en: A commercial product consisting of processed or raw animal flesh intended for consumption by pets, such as dogs or cats.

words.ex: The plane landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场安全着陆。
words.en: A plane is a vehicle designed for air travel that has wings and one or more engines.

words.tr: phrase. 行星科学；研究行星、卫星、彗星、小行星等天体及其形成、演化和性质的科学
words.ex: He studies planetary science to learn about planets.
words.ex_cn: 他学习行星科学来了解行星。
words.en: Planetary science is the scientific study of planets, moons, and planetary systems, in particular those of the Solar System and the processes that form them.

words.ex: The children are playing in the play area.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在游乐区玩耍。
words.en: A designated space where children can play, often equipped with toys and play structures.

words.ex: The children are playing in the playroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在游戏室里玩耍。
words.en: A playroom is a room in a house that is set aside for children to play in.

words.ex: The children are playing on the playground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上玩耍。
words.en: A playground is an area designed for children to play in, especially at a school or in a park.

words.tr: n. 均匀厚度的片状硬物体；盘子；碟子；“plate”的复数；
words.ex: The metal plates are used to build the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 这些金属片用于建造桥梁。
words.en: Plates are flat, usually round dishes that are used to hold food. They can also refer to thin, flat pieces of metal or other material.

words.tr:
n. 警方；警察部门；
v. 监督；
words.ex: The police caught the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警方昨晚抓到了小偷。
words.en: The police are the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law, for catching criminals, and for keeping public order.

words.ex: The police helicopters flew over the city.
words.ex_cn: 警察直升机飞过城市。
words.en: Helicopters used by the police force for surveillance, search and rescue, and law enforcement purposes.

words.tr: n. 土豆；马铃薯；“potato”的复数；
words.ex: I bought five potatoes at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上买了五个土豆。
words.en: Potatoes are starchy tubers that grow underground and are widely eaten as a staple food in many parts of the world.

words.tr: n. 水塘；水池；备用物资；美式撞球；
words.ex: The children play near the small pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小水塘边玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that is artificially created.

words.ex: The children are playing in the paddling pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在浅水池里玩耍。
words.en: A shallow pool for children to play in, especially one that can be filled with water and is portable.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.tr: n. 业务；练习；实践；惯常做法；“practice”的复数；
words.ex: The company improves its business practices every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会改进其业务。
words.en: The act of doing something regularly or repeatedly to improve skill or to follow a custom or law.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.ex: Students do practical work in the science lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生在科学实验室做实践操作。
words.en: Work that involves the practical application of theories or knowledge, especially in a professional or educational setting.

words.ex: He took a practical course to learn how to fix cars.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个实践课程来学习如何修车。
words.en: A course designed to provide hands-on experience or practical skills in a particular area.

words.tr: v. 保存；保护；保持；“preserve”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 防腐的；
words.ex: The old photos were preserved in a box.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧照片被保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: Kept in its original state or in good condition, especially over a long period of time.

words.ex: The museum focuses on the preservation of old books.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆专注于旧书的保存。
words.en: The act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition.

words.ex: The price of bread is too high.
words.ex_cn: 面包的价格太高了。
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: He taught math in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在小学教数学。
words.en: A primary school is a school for children between the ages of about five and eleven.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: The prisoners walked in a line to the yard.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯们排成一行走向院子。
words.en: A prisoner is a person who is kept in a prison as a punishment for a crime they have committed.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.ex: He owns private property near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有湖边的一处私人财产。
words.en: Private property refers to property owned by individuals or entities, not by the government or the public.

words.tr: phrase. 私人公司；股份不公开公司
words.ex: He works for a private company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家私营公司工作。
words.en: A private company is a business firm owned either by non-governmental organizations or by a relatively small number of shareholders or company members which does not offer or trade its company stock (shares) to the general public on the stock market exchanges, but rather the company's stock is offered, owned and traded or exchanged privately.

words.ex: I watch TV programmes every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上看电视节目。
words.en: A series of coded software instructions to control the operation of a computer or other machine.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 项目申请；项目要求
words.ex: He sent a project request to his manager.
words.ex_cn: 他向经理提交了一个项目请求。
words.en: A formal proposal submitted to request the initiation of a project, typically including details such as objectives, scope, and budget.

words.ex: The project background explains why we started this work.
words.ex_cn: 项目背景解释了我们为什么开始这项工作。
words.en: The project background refers to the context and circumstances that led to the initiation of a project, including the problem it aims to solve, the objectives it seeks to achieve, and the environment in which it operates.

words.ex: He wrote a project outline for his science fair.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的科学展览写了一个项目大纲。
words.en: A structured summary or plan that outlines the main objectives, key stages, and expected outcomes of a project or task.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: There are nine queens in the palace.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿里有九个女王。
words.en: A queen is a woman who rules a country as its monarch or who is the wife of a king.

words.ex: They bought a queen size bed for their new bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他们为新房间买了一张大号床。
words.en: A size of bed or mattress that is typically 60 inches wide and 80 inches long.

words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.ex: It is quite cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天很冷。
words.en: To a certain or fairly significant extent or degree; fairly.

words.ex: The students participated in a history quiz at school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了学校举办的历史知识竞赛。
words.en: A quiz is a test or a game in which someone asks you questions to find out how much you know about a subject.

words.tr:
n. 赛跑；竞争；种族；
v. 比赛；快速移动；
words.ex: He won the race by running fast.
words.ex_cn: 他通过快速奔跑赢得了赛跑。
words.en: A race is a competition to see who is the fastest, for example in running, swimming, or driving.

words.ex: He drives a race car on the track.
words.ex_cn: 他在赛道上开一辆赛车。
words.en: A race car is a car designed for high-speed racing, often with modifications for performance and safety.

words.ex: He walks to the railway station every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去火车站。
words.en: A railway station is a place where trains stop so that people can get on or off.

words.ex: The train runs on a long railway line.
words.ex_cn: 火车行驶在一条长长的铁路线上。
words.en: A railway line is the track along which trains run, connecting different places.

words.ex: The train runs on railway tracks.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: The parallel metal lines on which trains run.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.ex: We saw some rare trees in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 我们在森林里看到一些稀有树木。
words.en: Trees that are not commonly found and are considered precious due to their scarcity.

words.ex: Rats ran across the kitchen floor.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠跑过了厨房地板。
words.en: Rats are small rodents that are often considered pests.

words.ex: He gave two reasons for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了两个迟到的原因。
words.en: A cause, explanation, or justification for an action or event.

words.ex: He gave a reasonable answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个合理的回答。
words.en: Fair and sensible; not excessive or extreme.

words.tr: n. 回收利用； v. 再循环；“recycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Recycling helps reduce waste.
words.ex_cn: 回收利用有助于减少浪费。
words.en: The process of converting waste materials into new materials and objects.

words.ex: The factory uses recycled materials to make new bottles.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用可再生材料制造新瓶子。
words.en: Materials that have been processed and converted into raw materials for new products.

words.tr:
adj. 红的；
n. 红色；
words.ex: The apple is red.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果是红的。
words.en: Red is the colour of blood or of ripe tomatoes.

words.ex: Red blood cells carry oxygen in the body.
words.ex_cn: 红细胞在体内输送氧气。
words.en: Red blood cells, also known as erythrocytes, are the most common type of blood cell and the vertebrate organism's principal means of delivering oxygen (O2) to the body tissues—via blood flow through the circulatory system.

words.ex: The red flag waved in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 红旗在风中飘扬。
words.en: A red flag is a warning or indicator of a potential problem or danger.

words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

words.ex: The company must follow the safety regulations.
words.ex_cn: 公司必须遵守安全条例。
words.en: Regulations are rules or laws designed to control the way that something happens or is done.

words.ex: This room is relatively small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间相对较小。
words.en: In comparison with other similar things or with what you expect.

words.ex: Reading a book gives me relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 读书让我放松。
words.en: Relaxation is the state or process of becoming less tense, anxious, or stressed.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: Many religions teach kindness and peace.
words.ex_cn: 许多宗教教导善良与和平。
words.en: A religion is a particular system of belief in a god or gods and the activities that are connected with this system.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: Resources are materials, money, and other assets that can be used to function effectively.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.tr: n. 风险；“risk”的复数； v. 冒……风险；
words.ex: He knows the risks of climbing that mountain.
words.ex_cn: 他知道爬那座山的风险。
words.en: The possibility of something bad happening.

words.ex: The children collected rocks by the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边收集岩石。
words.en: Rocks are large pieces of stone that are found on the ground or in the sea. They can also refer to a type of music that is characterized by a strong beat and simple tunes.

words.ex: She picked red roses for her mother.
words.ex_cn: 她为母亲摘了红玫瑰。
words.en: Roses are a type of flower known for their beauty and fragrance, often used in gardens and as gifts.

words.ex: She walks in the rose garden every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上都在玫瑰园里散步。
words.en: A garden where roses are cultivated.

words.ex: The cat sat on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在屋顶上。
words.en: The roof of a building is the covering on top of it that protects the people and things inside from the weather.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 环绕；附近；
adj. 圆的；十足的；
n. 回合；圆形物；
v. 拐过；使成圆形；
words.ex: The children sat round the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们围坐在火堆旁。
words.en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or a ball.

words.ex: They sat at a round table to talk.
words.ex_cn: 他们围坐在一张圆桌旁交谈。
words.en: A round table is a meeting or discussion at which everyone has an equal chance to express their opinions, or a table that is round in shape.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: The company's sales increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 该公司上个月的销售额增加了。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.tr: n. 男推销员；男售货员；
words.ex: The salesman showed us new phones.
words.ex_cn: 那位男推销员给我们展示了新手机。
words.en: A salesman is a man whose job is to sell things, especially directly to shops or other businesses on behalf of a company.

words.ex: He is a sales manager at a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他是家小公司的销售经理。
words.en: A sales manager is a person who is responsible for leading and guiding a team of sales people in an organization. They set sales goals, analyze data, and develop training programs for sales representatives.

words.ex: She added salts to the water to make it taste better.
words.ex_cn: 她往水里加了盐，让它味道更好。
words.en: Salts are chemical compounds formed from the reaction of an acid with a base. They are composed of positive ions (cations) and negative ions (anions) and are typically crystalline solids at room temperature.

words.ex: The children built a castle in the sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在沙子里建了一座城堡。
words.en: Sand is a substance that consists of very small grains of rock, found on beaches and in deserts.

words.ex: The beach has sandy soil.
words.ex_cn: 这个海滩有含沙的土壤。
words.en: Covered with or consisting mostly of sand.

words.ex: The sandglass shows the time by falling sand.
words.ex_cn: 沙漏通过落下的沙子显示时间。
words.en: A sandglass is a device that measures time by the flow of sand from one glass bulb to another, typically taking a fixed amount of time to do so.

words.ex: I ate two sandwiches for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了两个三明治。
words.en: A sandwich is two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: The scientist tested the samples for bacteria.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这些样本进行了细菌检测。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of something that is taken to represent the whole.

words.ex: He felt satisfaction after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他完成作业后感到满意。
words.en: The feeling of pleasure that you have when you do or get something that you wanted or needed.

words.ex: The teacher gave a satisfactory grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个令人满意的分数。
words.en: If something is satisfactory, it is good enough or acceptable.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: Spring is a beautiful season.
words.ex_cn: 春天是一个美丽的季节。
words.en: A season is one of the four periods of the year: spring, summer, autumn, or winter. It can also refer to a period of the year characterized by particular conditions of weather, temperature, etc., or a period of the year when a particular sport is played.

words.ex: The store sells seasonal fruits like strawberries in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在春天出售草莓等季节性水果。
words.en: Seasonal means relating to or happening during a particular season.

words.tr: n. 座位安排；供给座位； v. “seat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The theater improved its seating for better comfort.
words.ex_cn: 剧院改进了座位安排以提升舒适度。
words.en: The arrangement of seats in a place, or the provision of seats for people to sit on.

words.ex: He made a seat reservation for the train.
words.ex_cn: 他为火车订了座位。
words.en: The act of reserving a seat in advance for an event or journey.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
