words.en: Having a great deal of money or assets; wealthy.

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天给你打电话。
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.ex: The name rings a bell, but I can't remember where I heard it.
words.ex_cn: 这个名字听起来有点耳熟，但我记不起在哪里听过。
words.en: If something rings a bell, it sounds familiar or you think you've heard it before, but you cannot remember exactly.

words.ex: The two teams are strong rivals in the league.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍是联赛中的强劲竞争者。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has no rivals or is without rival, you mean that it is the best of its type.

words.ex: The robot cleans the floor every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人每天打扫地板。
words.en: A robot is a machine that is programmed to move and perform certain tasks automatically.

words.ex: The rockets launched into the sky at night.
words.ex_cn: 火箭在夜晚升入天空。
words.en: A rocket is a missile, spacecraft, aircraft or other vehicle that obtains thrust from a rocket engine.

words.ex: The baby learned to roll over at three months.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝三个月大时学会了翻身。
words.en: To move by turning over and over on an axis; to defer or transfer something to a later time or another account.

words.ex: He ordered room service because he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他因为累了就点了客房服务。
words.en: Room service is a service provided by a hotel in which food and drink are brought to guests' rooms.

words.tr: n. 根；根源；根本；“root”的复数；
words.ex: The roots of the equation are 2 and 3.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程的根是2和3。
words.en: The underground parts of a plant that anchor it and absorb water and nutrients.

words.ex: The climbers grabbed the ropes to climb the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者抓住绳索来爬山。
words.en: Ropes are thick, strong strings made by twisting together several thinner strings. They are used for tying, pulling, or climbing.

words.ex: We took a different route to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们换了条路线以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A route is a way from one place to another, or the path that something follows to reach a destination.

words.tr: n. 跑；管理；运作； v. 经营；跑步；“run”的现在分词； adj. 运作中的；流动的；持续的；
words.ex: Running is his favorite exercise.
words.ex_cn: 跑步是他最喜欢的锻炼方式。
words.en: The act of moving swiftly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride.

words.ex: The runner won the race quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位跑步者很快赢得了比赛。
words.en: A runner is a person who runs, especially in a race or as a sport.

words.ex: The school has strict rules about uniforms.
words.ex_cn: 学校对校服有严格的规定。
words.en: Rules are statements that tell you what is or is not allowed in a particular situation or game, or instructions about how to behave or do something.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.ex: The sable is a small animal with soft black fur.
words.ex_cn: 黑貂是一种毛皮柔软的黑色小动物。
words.en: A sable is a small animal with valuable fur, or the fur of this animal used for making expensive clothes.

words.ex: The temple is a sacred place for believers.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙对信徒来说是神圣的地方。
words.en: Something that is sacred is considered to be holy or connected with God or a god.

words.ex: We saw lions and elephants in the safari park.
words.ex_cn: 我们在野生动物园看到了狮子和大象。
words.en: A safari park is a park where wild animals are kept in large enclosures for the public to see, often allowing visitors to drive through in their own vehicles.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.tr: n. 储蓄金；存款；“saving”的复数；
words.ex: He used his savings to buy a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的储蓄买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Money that someone has saved, especially in a bank or official scheme.

words.ex: He is savvy about technology.
words.ex_cn: 他对技术很有见识。
words.en: If you describe someone as savvy, you mean that they show a lot of practical knowledge and ability.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.ex: The loud noise scared the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something scares you, it frightens or worries you.

words.ex: The mountain scenery is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 山景非常美丽。
words.en: The natural features of a landscape considered in terms of their appearance, especially when picturesque.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.ex: He got high scores in the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: The number of points, goals, runs, etc., achieved in a game or by a team or an individual.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: He changes his search habits when he uses a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 当他换了一部新手机时，他会改变自己的搜索习惯。
words.en: The patterns of behavior that users exhibit when searching for information online, which can include the types of queries they use, the frequency of their searches, and their preferences for certain search engines or websites.

words.tr:
adj. 富有经验的；加佐料的；风干的
v. 给 ... 调味；适应；风干；“season”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is a seasoned cook with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的熟练厨师。
words.en: If someone is seasoned, they have a lot of experience of something and are therefore able to deal with it in a confident way.

words.tr: n. 封条；“seal”的复数； v. 封入；
words.ex: The box has red seals on the lid.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的盖子上有红色封条。
words.en: Seals are large marine mammals that live in cold seas and have thick fur and layers of fat to keep them warm. They are known for their ability to swim gracefully and their playful nature.

words.ex: Birds eat seeds from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿吃地上的种子。
words.en: Seeds are small, hard objects produced by plants, from which new plants grow.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

words.tr: phrase. 发送电子报刊；发送新闻稿
words.ex: They send newsletters every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期五发送新闻简报。
words.en: To distribute information or updates regularly to a group of people via electronic mail.

words.ex: He does sensible exercise every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上进行适度的锻炼。
words.en: Sensible exercise refers to physical activities that are reasonable and appropriate for maintaining or improving health.

words.ex: They settled in a small village after retirement.
words.ex_cn: 他们退休后在一个小村庄安顿下来。
words.en: To settle means to resolve or come to an agreement about a dispute, to establish a permanent home in a particular place, or to come to rest in a particular position.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.tr:
n. 荫；阴影；
v. 遮蔽；
words.ex: The tree provides shade on a hot day.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在炎热的日子提供荫凉。
words.en: Shade is an area where there is no direct sunlight, or something that provides protection from the sun. It can also refer to a slight difference in color, or to gradually change from one color or tone to another.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: He felt shame for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对母亲撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: A painful feeling of humiliation or distress caused by the consciousness of wrong or foolish behavior.

words.tr:
n. 形状；身材；定形；
v. 塑造；
words.ex: The shape of the table is round.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子的形状是圆形的。
words.en: The shape of an object is its external form or outline, which can be seen and felt.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.ex: The sheep graze quietly in the field.
words.ex_cn: 绵羊在田野里安静地吃草。
words.en: A sheep is a farm animal which is covered with thick curly hair called wool. Sheep are kept for their wool or for their meat.

words.ex: He wrote his name on a sheet of paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在一张纸上写了名字。
words.en: A sheet is a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or under. It can also refer to a flat, thin piece of material, such as paper, metal, or glass.

words.ex: He wears a white shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件白衬衫去上班。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing for the upper body, typically having a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.ex: He ate grilled shrimp for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤虾。
words.en: A shrimp is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten as food.

words.ex: The soldier shoot at the target.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向目标射击。
words.en: To shoot means to fire a bullet from a gun or to take a photograph. It can also refer to the act of a plant sprouting or a player attempting to score in sports by sending the ball or puck towards the goal.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.tr: n. 往返移动之物；航天飞机；
words.ex: The bus is a shuttle between the hotel and the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这辆巴士是酒店和机场之间的往返交通工具。
words.en: A shuttle is a vehicle that travels frequently between two places. In weaving, a shuttle is a device used to carry the weft thread back and forth across the loom.

words.ex: He uses a lot of slang when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时用很多俚语。
words.en: Slang refers to a type of language that consists of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, are more common in speech than writing, and are typically restricted to a particular context or group of people.

words.ex: The slaves worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这些奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is a person who is the legal property of another and is forced to obey them.

words.ex: He took sick pay when he had a fever.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧时请了病假工资。
words.en: Sick pay is money paid by an employer to an employee who is unable to work because of illness.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.tr: n. 信号；“signal”的复数； v. 预示；
words.ex: The radio receives signals from satellites.
words.ex_cn: 收音机接收来自卫星的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.ex: There was silence after the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 坏消息传来后，一片沉默。
words.en: The absence of sound; complete quiet.

words.ex: She wears a silk dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件丝绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A fine, strong, soft, lustrous fiber produced by silkworms in making cocoons and collected to make thread and fabric.

words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.ex: The singer sang a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在音乐会上唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A singer is a person who sings, especially as a profession.

words.ex: My sister walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹每天走路去上学。
words.en: A sister is a woman or girl who has one or both parents in common with another individual.

words.ex: The ancient sites attract many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这些古代场所吸引了许多游客。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.ex: The situation is very serious.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况非常严重。
words.en: A situation is all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place.

words.ex: He gave a situational answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个情境相关的回答。
words.en: Relating to or dependent on a set of circumstances or state of affairs.

words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: The sky is the space around the Earth which you can see when you stand outside and look upwards.

words.ex: The children play in smaller areas of the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园较小的区域玩耍。
words.en: A smaller area is a part of a larger space or region.

words.ex: He smashed the glass with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把玻璃打碎了。
words.en: To break something into pieces violently and noisily, or to cause something to do this by dropping, throwing, or hitting it.

words.ex: The smoke alarms beeped when the bread burned.
words.ex_cn: 当面包烤焦时，烟雾报警器响了。
words.en: Smoke alarms are devices that detect smoke, typically as an indicator of fire, and emit a loud sound to alert the occupants of a building.

words.ex: Children like to eat snacks after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在放学后吃零食。
words.en: Snacks are small amounts of food that are eaten between meals.

words.ex: He loves snowboarding in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在山上滑雪板。
words.en: Snowboarding is a winter sport that involves descending a slope that is covered with snow while standing on a snowboard, a flat board with bindings for the rider's feet.

words.ex: The doctor tried to stabilize the patient's heart rate.
words.ex_cn: 医生试图稳定病人的脉搏。
words.en: To stabilize something means to make it stable or to prevent it from changing or declining.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: He walked up the stairs to his bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去他的卧室。
words.en: A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, typically inside the building.

words.ex: He uses a stair lift to go up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他使用楼梯升降机上楼。
words.en: A stair lift is a mechanical device for lifting people and wheelchairs up and down stairs.

words.ex: The stars shine brightly at night.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜晚明亮地闪耀。
words.en: Stars are celestial bodies that appear as points of light in the night sky. They are massive, luminous spheres of plasma held together by gravity.

words.ex: We went to a state park to hike and see animals.
words.ex_cn: 我们去州立公园徒步并看动物。
words.en: A state park is an area of land or water that is protected by a state government for the enjoyment of the public or the preservation of wildlife.

words.ex: He gave a clear statement position about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 他就新政策表明了明确的情况声明。
words.en: Statement position refers to the viewpoint or stance one takes when making a claim or argument.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在门附近。
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.ex: The kettle produces steam when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生蒸汽。
words.en: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. It can be used to power machines or to cook food.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.tr: v. 阻止；遏止； n. 茎；“stem”的复数；
words.ex: The new law stems the flow of illegal goods.
words.ex_cn: 新法律阻止了非法商品的流动。
words.en: The main body or stalk of a plant or shrub, typically rising above ground but occasionally subterranean. Also refers to the main upright part of a wine glass or similar object. As a verb, it means to originate in or be caused by; to stop or restrict (the flow of something).

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.ex: The boy put stickers on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把贴纸贴在了他的笔记本上。
words.en: Stickers are small pieces of paper or plastic with pictures or writing on one side and a sticky substance on the other, used for decorating or labeling.

words.ex: The bright lights caused stimulation in her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的灯光引起了她眼睛的刺激。
words.en: The act of arousing or accelerating physiological or psychological activity or response in an organism or any of its parts.

words.tr:
v. 叮；“sting”的第三人称单数
n. 蜇伤；“sting”的复数
words.ex: The bee stings hurt a lot.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂的刺很疼。
words.en: If a plant, animal, or insect stings you, it pricks your skin and puts poison into your body, causing you pain.

words.tr: n. 新来者；陌生人； adj. “strange”的比较级；
words.ex: He is a stranger in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个镇上的新来者。
words.en: A stranger is someone you have never met before.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.tr:
adv. 径直；直接；直；
adj. 直的；
words.ex: He walked straight to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他径直走向门。
words.en: extending or moving uniformly in one direction only; without a curve or bend.

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: My teacher is strict about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业截止日期要求很严格。
words.en: If someone is strict, they behave firmly and make sure that rules are obeyed.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.tr: adj. 被偷走的； v. 偷；“steal”的过去分词；
words.ex: The stolen bike was found near the park.
words.ex_cn: 那辆被偷的自行车在公园附近找到了。
words.en: Taken without the owner's consent; obtained by theft.

words.ex: The box has enough storage space for toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子有足够的存储空间来放玩具。
words.en: The area or capacity available for storing data, files, or other materials in a computer or other device.

words.ex: He fastened the strap around his wrist.
words.ex_cn: 他把带子系在手腕上。
words.en: A strap is a narrow piece of leather, cloth, or other material that is used to fasten, secure, or carry something, or to hold onto something.

words.ex: He is stretching his arms before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前伸展手臂。
words.en: The act of making something longer or wider by pulling it.

words.ex: He used a stopwatch to time the race.
words.ex_cn: 他用秒表计时比赛。
words.en: A stopwatch is a watch that can be started and stopped by pressing a button, used for timing events accurately.

words.tr: adj. 卡住的；受困的； v. 粘贴；“stick”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The door is stuck and won't open.
words.ex_cn: 门卡住了，打不开。
words.en: If something is stuck in a particular position, it is fixed tightly in this position and is unable to move.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.ex: He washes his hands with soap.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning, made of a compound of natural oils or fats with sodium hydroxide or another strong alkali, and typically also perfume and coloring.

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末踢足球。
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.ex: The soldiers marched in a line.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们列队行进。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: He put on his socks before leaving the house.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了袜子。
words.en: A piece of clothing which covers your foot and lower part of your leg, usually made of wool or cotton.

words.tr:
n. 种类；类别；
v. 理清；解决；把…分类；拣选；
words.ex: This store sells all sorts of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。
words.en: A sort is a kind or category of things or people which have similar characteristics.

words.ex: She loves to listen to old songs.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢听老歌。
words.en: A song is a short piece of music with words that are sung.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他正在吃汤当午餐。
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.ex: He keeps spare keys under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把备用钥匙放在垫子下面。
words.en: Spare keys are additional keys made for locks, kept as a backup in case the original keys are lost or misplaced.

words.ex: We have a spare room for guests.
words.ex_cn: 我们有一个空房间给客人住。
words.en: A spare room is a room in a house that is not regularly used and is available for guests to stay in.

words.ex: The ancient warriors carried spears into battle.
words.ex_cn: 古代战士带着矛上战场。
words.en: A spear is a weapon consisting of a long pole with a sharp pointed end, used for thrusting or throwing.

words.ex: He gave three speeches last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周做了三场演说。
words.en: Speeches are formal addresses or discourses delivered to an audience.

words.ex: The boy hurt his spine when he fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他从树上摔下来时伤到了脊柱。
words.en: The spine is the row of bones down the center of your back that supports your body and protects your spinal cord.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.ex: He drinks spring water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝泉水。
words.en: Water that comes from a natural spring, often considered to be pure and healthy.

words.tr: n. 对象；学科；主题；“subject”的复数；
words.ex: The subjects of the painting are two children playing.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的对象是两个玩耍的孩子。
words.en: Subjects can refer to topics of study or discussion, the people or things that are being discussed or considered, or the people who are ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: The teacher listed three subtopics for the essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师列出了论文的三个子主题。
words.en: Subtopics are smaller or more specific topics within a larger subject or topic.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.ex: The company offers 24/7 support services for its software users.
words.ex_cn: 该公司为其软件用户提供24/7技术支持。
words.en: Support services refer to the various forms of assistance provided to individuals or organizations to help them achieve their goals or solve problems. These services can include technical support, customer service, and any other help that supports the main functions of a business or activity.

words.tr: adj. 支持的；支援的；给予帮助的；
words.ex: My parents are supportive when I study hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我努力学习时，我的父母总是支持我。
words.en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

words.tr: n. 冲浪运动； v. 冲浪；“surf”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves surfing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末冲浪。
words.en: Surfing is the sport of riding on the top of a wave while standing or lying on a special board.

words.tr:
n. 惊讶；意外；惊喜；
v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；
words.ex: She felt a surprise when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，感到很惊讶。
words.en: If something surprises you, it happens unexpectedly and causes you to feel surprise.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.ex: She wears warm sweaters in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天穿暖和的毛衣。
words.en: Sweaters are knitted garments for the upper body, typically with long sleeves, worn for warmth.

words.ex: He adds sweetener to his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他往咖啡里加甜味剂。
words.en: A sweetener is a substance used to sweeten food or drink, especially one that does not contain sugar.

words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: To turn off a device or light by using a switch.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.ex: The dog wagged its tail happily.
words.ex_cn: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。
words.en: The tail of an animal, bird, or fish is the part extending beyond the end of its body.

words.ex: He filled the tank with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把罐子装满了水。
words.en: A tank is a large container for holding liquid or gas, or a heavily armored fighting vehicle carrying guns and moving on a continuous articulated metal track.

words.ex: He finished his homework task before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了他的作业任务。
words.en: A task is a piece of work to be done or undertaken.

words.ex: He drinks tea every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝茶。
words.en: Tea is a drink made by pouring boiling water onto the dried leaves of the tea bush. It is popular in many countries and is often served hot with milk and sugar.

words.ex: She cried until her tears fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 她哭得眼泪掉到了地上。
words.en: Tears are the drops of salty liquid that come out of your eyes when you cry.

words.ex: He brushed his teeth every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刷牙。
words.en: The hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: He watches a television program every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看一个电视节目。
words.en: A television program is a segment of content intended for broadcast on television. It may be a fictional show, such as a comedy or drama, or a non-fictional show, such as a documentary or news program.

words.ex: He watches television drama every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视剧。
words.en: A television drama is a type of program that tells a story through a series of episodes, often focusing on character development and emotional themes.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.ex: The temple walls have old carvings.
words.ex_cn: 寺庙的墙壁上有古老的雕刻。
words.en: The walls of a temple, often significant for their architectural features, inscriptions, or artwork.

words.tr:
n. 术语；学期；期限；措辞；
v. 把…称作；把…叫做；
words.ex: The word 'algorithm' is a technical term in computer science.
words.ex_cn: ‘算法’是计算机科学中的一个术语。
words.en: A term is a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, especially one that has a specific meaning, or a fixed period of time during which something lasts or is intended to happen.

words.ex: The house has a small terrace with chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个带椅子的小平台。
words.en: A terrace is a flat area of stone or grass next to a building where people can sit.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.tr:
adj. 第三的；
n. 三分之一；第三；
adv. 第三；
words.ex: He finished in third place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第三名。
words.en: Coming after the second and just before the fourth in position.

words.ex: He thinks quickly when solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时思维敏捷。
words.en: To think quickly is to process information or make decisions rapidly.

words.ex: The thunderstorm woke us up at night.
words.ex_cn: 雷雨在夜里把我们吵醒了。
words.en: A thunderstorm is a storm with thunder and lightning and typically also heavy rain or hail.

words.ex: The tides rise and fall twice a day.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每天涨落两次。
words.en: The regular rise and fall in the level of the sea, caused by the gravitational pull of the moon and sun.

words.ex: The tiger walks quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 老虎在森林里静静地行走。
words.en: A tiger is a large wild animal that has a yellow and black striped coat and is a member of the cat family.

words.ex: He bought timber to build a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他买了木材来建篱笆。
words.en: Wood prepared for use in building and carpentry.

words.ex: He changed his titles on the business card.
words.ex_cn: 他更改了名片上的头衔。
words.en: A title is a word or phrase that is used to describe someone's position or job, or to describe something such as a book, film, or piece of music.

words.ex: He uses a toaster to make toast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用烤面包机烤面包。
words.en: A toaster is an electric device for making toast by heating slices of bread on both sides.

words.ex: His tolerance for different opinions is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他对不同观点的宽容令人印象深刻。
words.en: The ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with.

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 马桶坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.tr: n. 西红柿；番茄；“tomato”的复数；
words.ex: I bought fresh tomatoes at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上买了新鲜的西红柿。
words.en: Tomatoes are soft, red fruit that can be eaten raw in salads or cooked as a vegetable.

words.tr: n. 音调；语气；强健状况；色调；氛围；
words.ex: His tone sounded angry.
words.ex_cn: 他的音调听起来很生气。
words.en: The tone of a sound is its particular quality. In music, tone refers to the pitch of a note. In art, tone refers to the lightness or darkness of a color. In speech, tone refers to the quality of the voice which expresses the speaker's feelings or intentions.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.ex: He has a toothache and cannot eat.
words.ex_cn: 他牙疼，不能吃东西。
words.en: A toothache is a pain in or around a tooth.

words.ex: The paper was torn in half.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸被撕成了两半。
words.en: If you are torn between two or more things, you cannot decide which to choose, and so you feel anxious or troubled.

words.tr: v. 触摸；接触；“touch”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child is touching the soft blanket.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在触摸柔软的毯子。
words.en: If something is touching, it causes feelings of sadness or sympathy.

words.tr:
n. 痕迹；轨迹；微量；
v. 追踪；追溯；仔细查找；
words.ex: There was no trace of blood on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上没有血迹。
words.en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, you draw it carefully over a piece of thin paper. You can also trace someone or something that is missing or has disappeared, by following their movements or actions.

words.ex: The browser uses tracking protection to stop websites from following you.
words.ex_cn: 浏览器使用跟踪保护来阻止网站追踪你。
words.en: A feature or system designed to prevent tracking of a user's online activities, typically to enhance privacy.

words.ex: The translator helped him understand the French book.
words.ex_cn: 这位翻译员帮他理解了这本法语书。
words.en: A translator is a person whose job is translating writing or speech from one language to another.

words.ex: The translation of the book took two months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的翻译花了两个月。
words.en: The process of translating words or text from one language into another.

words.tr: n. 垃圾；无价值的东西；
words.ex: The trash bin is full.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾桶满了。
words.en: Waste material or unwanted things that are thrown away.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: Social media trends change quickly.
words.ex_cn: 社交媒体的趋势变化很快。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；正确的；
words.ex: The story is true.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事是真实的。
words.en: in accordance with fact or reality

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.tr:
v. 转变；转动；转弯；转身；
n. 转变；轮到的机会；
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在你离开前关掉灯。
words.en: To move or cause to move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis or point.

words.ex: He eats tuna for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃金枪鱼。
words.en: A tuna is a large fish that lives in warm seas and is caught for food.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.tr: v. 打字；定型；“type”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is typing a letter on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他正在电脑上打一封信。
words.en: The act of writing something using a typewriter or computer keyboard.

words.ex: He opened his umbrella when it started to rain.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他打开了伞。
words.en: An umbrella is a device consisting of a circular canopy of fabric on a folding metal frame, used as protection against rain or sunlight.

words.tr: n. 叔父；伯父；舅父；姑父；姨父；
words.ex: My uncle works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔父在当地一家银行工作。
words.en: The brother of someone's father or mother, or the husband of someone's aunt.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.ex: This broken phone is useless.
words.ex_cn: 这部坏掉的手机毫无用处。
words.en: If something is useless, it is not able to do what it is supposed to do or is not effective.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.ex: He went upstairs to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼去睡觉了。
words.en: If you go upstairs in a building, you go up a staircase towards a higher floor.

words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我理解这个数学问题。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.ex: The company is doing vetting for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司正在对新员工进行背景审查。
words.en: The process of carefully and critically examining someone or something, especially to ensure suitability or safety.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.tr: phrase. 视觉教具；视觉辅助工具
words.ex: The teacher uses visual aids to help students understand.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用视觉辅助工具帮助学生理解。
words.en: Visual aids are items of visual material, such as films, slides, photographs, etc., used to enhance understanding or memory of information.

words.tr:
n. 声音；意见；
v. 表达；
words.ex: I heard a loud voice from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来很大的声音。
words.en: Your voice is the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

words.ex: The volcanic ash covered the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 火山灰覆盖了附近的城镇。
words.en: Fine particles of rock and mineral ejected into the atmosphere by a volcanic eruption.

words.ex: He did voluntary work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做志愿工作。
words.en: If something is voluntary, you do it because you choose to, and not because you have to.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.tr:
v. 观看；观察；小心；
n. 手表；监视；注意；
words.ex: I watch TV every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上看电视。
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.ex: He lost his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上丢了钱包。
words.en: A wallet is a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic, in which you can keep banknotes, credit cards, and other small flat objects.

words.tr:
v. 等待；等候；
n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: to stay in one place or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives, etc.

words.tr: n. 步行； v. 步行；行走；“walk”的现在分词； adj. 步行的；
words.ex: Walking is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 步行对健康有益。
words.en: Walking is the activity of going for a walk, especially for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: He bought new walking boots for the hike.
words.ex_cn: 他为远足买了新的1058型徒步靴。
words.en: Walking boots are sturdy footwear designed for walking long distances, typically used for hiking or trekking.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.tr: n. 除杂草； v. “weed”的现在分词；
words.ex: Weeding the garden takes most of my weekend.
words.ex_cn: 除杂草占用了我整个周末的时间。
words.en: The act of removing unwanted plants from a garden or other area.

words.tr:
int. 欢迎；
v. 欢迎；
adj. 受欢迎的；
n. 欢迎；
words.ex: Welcome to our school!
words.ex_cn: 欢迎来到我们的学校！
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.ex: The government provides welfare to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府向贫困家庭提供福利。
words.en: The welfare of a person or group is their health, comfort, and happiness.

words.ex: He wears a wetsuit to swim in cold water.
words.ex_cn: 他穿潜水服在冷水中游泳。
words.en: A wetsuit is a close-fitting garment made of rubber or neoprene, worn by surfers, divers, and others who engage in water sports in cold water, to keep their bodies warm.

words.ex: He blew a whistle to get our attention.
words.ex_cn: 他吹了一声口哨来引起我们的注意。
words.en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention. A whistle is also the sound that you make when you blow a whistle or when you whistle.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.tr:
adj. 广泛的；宽的；宽阔的；
adv. 广大地；
words.ex: The book has wide use in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side to the other.

words.tr: adj. 愿意的；乐意的； v. “will”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is willing to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If someone is willing to do something, they are happy to do it if it is needed.

words.ex: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞走了。
words.en: The wings of a bird or insect are the two parts of its body that it uses for flying.

words.ex: The fence is made of strong wires.
words.ex_cn: 这个围栏是由坚固的钢丝制成的。
words.en: Wires are long thin pieces of metal that are used to carry electricity or electronic signals.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr: n. 单词；字；话语；“word”的复数；
words.ex: He learned new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习新单词。
words.en: Words are the basic units of language used to communicate ideas.

words.ex: The students complete their math exercises in workbooks.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在练习本上完成数学练习。
words.en: A workbook is a book of problems or practice examples for a student to use as part of their studies.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.tr:
adj. 交替的；轮流的；间隔的；
v. （使）交替；（使）轮流；
words.ex: We take alternate days off work.
words.ex_cn: 我们隔天休息一次。
words.en: If something alternates between two things, it repeatedly changes from one to the other and back again.

words.ex: The archaeologist found an old pot in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 这位考古学家在地下发现了一个旧陶罐。
words.en: An archaeologist is someone who studies the societies and cultures of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.ex: It is apparent that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is apparent, it seems to be true, although you cannot be certain that it is.

words.tr:
v. 把…联系在一起；
adj. 副的；
n. 同事；伙伴；
words.ex: He associates happiness with family time.
words.ex_cn: 他把幸福与家庭时光联系在一起。
words.en: If you associate someone or something with a particular quality or idea, or if they are associated with it, you connect them in your mind with that quality or idea.

words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built the pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人建造了金字塔。
words.en: Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.ex: The water supply is adequate for the village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对这个村庄来说是足够的。
words.en: If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.ex: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是一种习俗。
words.en: A convention is a large meeting of an organization or political group, or a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.ex: The critic praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位评论家称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.ex: We should conserve water in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们应在日常生活中节约用水。
words.en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change, especially in order to preserve it for the future.

words.ex: Lying has serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎会有严重的后果。
words.en: A consequence is a result or effect of an action or condition.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: The dominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间占优势的颜色是蓝色。
words.en: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.ex: The two colors are distinct.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色有区别。
words.en: If something is distinct, it is easily seen, heard, or understood.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: The establishment of the school took five years.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的建立花了五年时间。
words.en: The act of establishing something or the state of being established. It can also refer to an organization or institution, especially a business or public body.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: The teacher put emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.ex: I can't find my keys here; they must be elsewhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在这儿找不到我的钥匙，它们一定在别处。
words.en: In or to some other place; not here.

words.ex: The existence of life on other planets is still unknown.
words.ex_cn: 其他星球上是否存在生命仍不清楚。
words.en: The state or fact of existing; being.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.ex: The children were exposed to cold weather without coats.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在没有外套的情况下遭受了寒冷天气。
words.en: To expose something means to uncover it so that it can be seen, or to make it known or public.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.ex: People gather in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 人们在广场上聚集庆祝节日。
words.en: If people gather somewhere, or if someone gathers people somewhere, they come together in a group.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.ex: The hospital will isolate the patient to stop the spread.
words.ex_cn: 医院将隔离这名病人以防止传播。
words.en: To isolate someone or something means to separate them from other people or things, often in order to protect them or to prevent the spread of something harmful.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.ex: The detective gave an investigative report.
words.ex_cn: 侦探提交了一份调查报告。
words.en: Involving or relating to the investigation of something, especially in a thorough and systematic way.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.ex: He took an intensive English course last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他参加了一个密集的英语课程。
words.en: Intensive is used to describe something that involves a lot of effort, energy, or attention in a short period of time.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.ex: He loves reading literary books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读文学书籍。
words.en: Literary means concerned with or connected with the writing, study, or appreciation of literature.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: He was a pioneer in space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 他是太空探索的先驱者。
words.en: A pioneer is someone who is one of the first people to do something that others will later develop or continue. Pioneers are also people who are among the first to go to live in a new area, especially in the past when people were trying to settle in new lands.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.ex: The rainbow is a natural phenomenon.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹是一种自然现象。
words.en: A phenomenon is something that is observed to happen or exist, especially something that is unusual or interesting.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: He primarily works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他主要是一名老师。
words.en: You use primarily to say what is mainly true in a particular situation.

words.ex: Prior to the meeting, we reviewed the report.
words.ex_cn: 在会议之前，我们复习了报告。
words.en: Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.ex: The law restricts driving after drinking.
words.ex_cn: 法律限制酒后驾驶。
words.en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: He failed the test, but subsequent efforts helped him pass.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，但随后的努力让他通过了。
words.en: Following in time or order; succeeding.

words.ex: The farmer works hard to sustain his crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民努力维持他的庄稼。
words.en: To sustain something means to continue it or maintain it for a period of time.

words.ex: Water is a common substance.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的物质。
words.en: A substance is a particular kind of matter with uniform properties.

words.tr: adj. 最终的；最后的；极端的；
words.ex: This is the ultimate solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个问题的最终解决方案。
words.en: You use ultimate to describe the final result or aim of a long series of events.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.ex: The anthropologist studies ancient tribes.
words.ex_cn: 这位人类学家研究古代部落。
words.en: An anthropologist is a person who studies anthropology, which is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: The car's acceleration increased when the driver pressed the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当司机踩油门时，汽车的加速度增加了。
words.en: Acceleration is the rate at which a car or other vehicle can increase its speed, often measured in the time it takes to go from 0 to 60 miles per hour.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.tr: n. 人工制品；手工艺品；加工品
words.ex: The museum has an ancient artifact.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一件古代文物。
words.en: An artifact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.ex: There is an abundance of food at the party.
words.ex_cn: 聚会上食物非常丰富。
words.en: A very large quantity of something.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.ex: He worked hard to attain his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到他的目标。
words.en: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.ex: He abandoned his car in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他把车抛弃在雪地里。
words.en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

words.ex: The accuracy of the clock is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟的精确性很高。
words.en: The quality or state of being correct or precise.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: I anticipate rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我预料明天会下雨。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.ex: The music accompanies the dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随舞蹈。
words.en: To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to play a musical accompaniment for.

words.ex: The detective tried to ascertain the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探试图查明真相。
words.en: If you ascertain the truth about something, you find out what it is, especially by making a deliberate effort to do so.

words.ex: The auditory system helps us hear sounds.
words.ex_cn: 听觉系统帮助我们听到声音。
words.en: Relating to the sense of hearing.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.tr: n. 影响；方位；轴承；举止； v. 忍受；“bear”的现在分词；
words.ex: The new policy has a big bearing on our daily lives.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策对我们日常生活有很大影响。
words.en: The manner in which one conducts or carries oneself, including posture and gestures; also refers to a machine part that supports another part and reduces friction.

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.ex: Children develop cognitive skills as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在成长过程中发展认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive means relating to the mental process involved in knowing, learning, and understanding things.

words.ex: He has a chronic cough that lasts for months.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个持续数月的慢性咳嗽。
words.en: A chronic illness or condition lasts for a long time and cannot be cured, but it can usually be controlled.

words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.ex: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植水稻。
words.en: To cultivate land means to prepare it and grow crops on it. To cultivate a particular quality, skill, or attitude means to try hard to develop it and make it stronger.

words.ex: He could not conceive a world without technology.
words.ex_cn: 他无法设想一个没有科技的世界。
words.en: To conceive means to form or devise a plan or idea in the mind; to become pregnant.

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.ex: The law constrains companies from polluting rivers.
words.ex_cn: 法律约束公司不得污染河流。
words.en: To constrain someone or something means to limit their development or force them to behave in a particular way.

words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.tr:
n. 硬币；金属钱币；
v. 创造；
words.ex: He has a coin in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有一枚硬币。
words.en: A coin is a small, flat, round piece of metal or plastic that is used as money.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.ex: The teacher gave a cue to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了开始游戏的提示。
words.en: A cue is a signal for someone to do something, or a piece of information that helps someone to understand something.

words.ex: His opinion coincides with mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的一致。
words.en: If one event coincides with another, they happen at the same time.

words.ex: The data points correlate with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些数据点相互关联。
words.en: If one thing correlates with another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one thing causes the other.

words.ex: The teacher gave a comprehensive review before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试前给了一个全面的复习。
words.en: Something that is comprehensive includes everything that is needed or relevant.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.ex: The company will compensate you for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 公司会因延误而补偿你。
words.en: If you compensate for a lack of something or for something you have done wrong, you do something to show that you are sorry or that you are trying to make things better.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability or potential to do it.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: The child's curiosity made him ask many questions.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的好奇心让他问了很多问题。
words.en: A desire to know or learn about something; something that is interesting because it is unusual or strange.

words.ex: He contradicts what she said.
words.ex_cn: 他反驳了她的话。
words.en: If you contradict someone, you say that what they have just said is wrong, or you suggest that it is wrong by saying something different.

words.ex: He conveyed his thanks with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着表达了谢意。
words.en: If you convey information or a message, you communicate it to someone, often in a way that is not direct.

words.ex: The number of apples corresponds to the number of oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的数量与橙子的数量相对应。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is the cause or the result of the other.

words.ex: The noise will diminish after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后噪音会减少。
words.en: If something diminishes, or if something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

words.ex: We derive the answer from the formula.
words.ex_cn: 我们从公式中得到答案。
words.en: If you derive something such as pleasure or benefit from a person or from something, you get it from them.

words.ex: The storm left debris on the road.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在道路上留下了碎片。
words.en: The remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up.

words.tr: n. 采伐森林；森林开伐；
words.ex: Deforestation is killing many animals.
words.ex_cn: 采伐森林正在杀死许多动物。
words.en: The act of cutting down or burning all the trees in an area.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: The earthquake devastated the small town.
words.ex_cn: 地震摧毁了这个小镇。
words.en: To devastate means to destroy or ruin something completely, or to cause someone to feel extreme sadness or shock.

words.ex: The company made drastic cuts to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司进行了急剧的削减以节省资金。
words.en: If you describe a change or action as drastic, you mean that it is extreme and often severe.

words.ex: The painting depicts a quiet village at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一个宁静的村庄在日落时分的景象。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.tr:
n. 纠纷；争端；
v. 对（某事）有异议；
words.ex: The dispute between the two neighbors was about the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间的纠纷是关于篱笆的。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.tr: adj. 值得拥有的；令人渴望的；称心如意的；
words.ex: A quiet neighborhood is desirable for families.
words.ex_cn: 安静的社区对家庭来说是值得拥有的。
words.en: Something that is desirable is worth having or doing because it is useful, necessary, or popular.

words.ex: The loud music distract me from my homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我无法专心做作业。
words.en: If something distracts you or your attention, it makes you stop concentrating on what you are doing.

words.ex: The mirror distorts my face.
words.ex_cn: 这面镜子扭曲了我的脸。
words.en: If you distort a statement, fact, or idea, you report or represent it in an untrue way.

words.ex: He can deduce the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他能从线索中推断出答案。
words.en: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

words.ex: The sun descends behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在山后落下。
words.en: If you descend or if you descend a staircase, you move downwards from a higher to a lower level.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: We must eliminate the waste to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除浪费以保护环境。
words.en: To eliminate something, especially something you do not want or need, means to remove it completely.

words.ex: He exaggerates his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他夸张自己的成就来给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.ex: The excavation revealed ancient pottery.
words.ex_cn: 挖掘发现了古代陶器。
words.en: The process of digging up and removing earth, especially at an archaeological site.

words.tr: v. 侵蚀；腐蚀；逐渐丧失；削弱
words.ex: The wind erodes the sand slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢侵蚀着沙子。
words.en: If rock or soil erodes or is eroded by the weather, sea, or wind, it cracks and breaks so that it is gradually destroyed.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr:
v. 遭遇；遇到；邂逅；
n. 遭遇；
words.ex: He encountered a bear while hiking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里徒步时遭遇了一只熊。
words.en: If you encounter problems or difficulties, you experience them.

words.ex: He decided to embark on a new career.
words.ex_cn: 他决定从事一份新职业。
words.en: To embark on something means to start it, especially something new, difficult, or exciting.

words.tr: n. 道德规范；伦理标准；
words.ex: The company follows a strong ethic of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司遵循诚实的道德规范。
words.en: An ethic is a moral principle or set of moral principles that guides the behavior of a person or group, especially in a professional context.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.ex: Water causes erosion of the soil.
words.ex_cn: 水会导致土壤腐蚀。
words.en: The process by which the surface of the earth is worn away by the action of water, glaciers, winds, waves, etc.

words.ex: The lamp emits a soft light.
words.ex_cn: 灯发出柔和的光。
words.en: To emit means to send out something such as light, heat, sound, gas, etc.

words.ex: The team went on an expedition to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍去山上探险了。
words.en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

words.ex: He exploited the situation to get more money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用这个情况赚了更多钱。
words.en: To exploit someone or something means to use them in a way that benefits you, often unfairly or without considering their rights or feelings. It can also refer to the act of making full use of and deriving benefit from a resource.

words.ex: The essence of love is caring for others.
words.ex_cn: 爱的本质是关心他人。
